units.id: mission:Remnant: Visit to Paradise 1|	You are just settling down at a table in the cafeteria when Taely slides onto the bench opposite you. "Greetings, <first>. How is life as an adventurer?"|36|0
units.english: You are just settling down at a table in the cafeteria when Taely slides onto the bench opposite you. "Greetings, <first>. How is life as an adventurer?"
units.italian: Mentre ti stai appena sistemando a un tavolo della mensa, Taely scivola sulla panca di fronte a te. "Salve, <first>. Come va la vita da avventuriero?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Visit to Paradise 1|	"Exciting as always."|38|0
units.english: "Exciting as always."
units.italian: "Emozionante come sempre."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Visit to Paradise 1|	"I am taking a break right now."|39|0
units.english: "I am taking a break right now."
units.italian: "Al momento mi sto prendendo una pausa."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Visit to Paradise 1|	She nods sympathetically. "Things have been a bit hectic lately, what with dimensional pockets and mysterious new aliens. I can understand wanting to slow down a bit. With the launch of two new ships in such a short time, I know I feel like I need to just relax a bit." She sighs. "It makes me feel guilty, honestly. I have accomplished so much, and there are so many things to be grateful for, but I even have more projects in development to focus on." She looks lost in thought for a moment.|40|0
units.english: She nods sympathetically. "Things have been a bit hectic lately, what with dimensional pockets and mysterious new aliens. I can understand wanting to slow down a bit. With the launch of two new ships in such a short time, I know I feel like I need to just relax a bit." She sighs. "It makes me feel guilty, honestly. I have accomplished so much, and there are so many things to be grateful for, but I even have more projects in development to focus on." She looks lost in thought for a moment.
units.italian: Annuisce con comprensione. "Le cose sono state un po' frenetiche ultimamente, tra dimensioni tasca e misteriosi nuovi alieni. Capisco la voglia di rallentare un po'. Con il varo di due navi nuove in così poco tempo, so che anch'io sento il bisogno di rilassarmi un po'." Sospira. "A dire il vero mi fa sentire in colpa. Ho ottenuto così tanto, e ci sono tante cose per cui essere grata, ma ho persino altri progetti in sviluppo su cui concentrarmi." Per un momento sembra persa nei pensieri.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Visit to Paradise 1|	Taely looks up at you. "Could I ask you something about life back in ancestral space?"|41|0
units.english: Taely looks up at you. "Could I ask you something about life back in ancestral space?"
units.italian: Taely alza lo sguardo su di te. "Posso chiederti qualcosa sulla vita nello spazio ancestrale?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Visit to Paradise 1|	"Sure."|43|0
units.english: "Sure."
units.italian: "Certo."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Visit to Paradise 1|	"Not right now."|45|0

units.italian: "Non adesso."

units.english: "Oh, maybe some other time, then." She looks disappointed, and settles in to eat.
units.italian: "Oh, sarà per un'altra volta, allora." Sembra delusa e si accomoda a mangiare.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Visit to Paradise 1|	"I have been reading through the history archive you brought back, and I came across a mention of Vail." She shakes her head in amusement. "The idea of an entire planet devoted to hoverboarding and leisure activities seems so extravagant... Well, I am curious to visit it. Now, this is not a mission we are asking you to do, so I cannot offer any logistics compensation. I could, however, show you some of our history in exchange. Are you interested?"|50|0
units.english: "I have been reading through the history archive you brought back, and I came across a mention of Vail." She shakes her head in amusement. "The idea of an entire planet devoted to hoverboarding and leisure activities seems so extravagant... Well, I am curious to visit it. Now, this is not a mission we are asking you to do, so I cannot offer any logistics compensation. I could, however, show you some of our history in exchange. Are you interested?"
units.italian: "Ho letto l'archivio storico che hai riportato, e mi sono imbattuta in un riferimento a Vail." Scuote la testa divertita. "L'idea di un intero pianeta dedicato all'hoverboard e alle attività ricreative sembra così stravagante... Beh, sono curiosa di visitarlo. Ora, questa non è una missione che ti chiediamo di svolgere, quindi non posso offrirti alcun compenso logistico. Potrei però mostrarti un po' della nostra storia in cambio. Ti interessa?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Visit to Paradise 1|	"Yes, that sounds fun."|52|0
units.english: "Yes, that sounds fun."
units.italian: "Sì, sembra divertente."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Visit to Paradise 1|	"Sure, I have done a bit of hoverboarding myself."|54|0
units.english: "Sure, I have done a bit of hoverboarding myself."
units.italian: "Certo, anch'io ho fatto un po' di hoverboard."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Visit to Paradise 1|	"Maybe later."|55|0
units.english: "Maybe later."
units.italian: "Forse più tardi."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Visit to Paradise 1|	"Really? The description sounded useful for exploration, and it looked challenging." Her commlink shifts to display a hologram of a hoverboarder executing a jump with an artistic poof of snow around them. "Anyway, I think this trip should be a good diversion for us both. units.english: "Really? The description sounded useful for exploration, and it looked challenging." Her commlink shifts to display a hologram of a hoverboarder executing a jump with an artistic poof of snow around them. "Anyway, I think this trip should be a good diversion for us both. I will meet you onboard the <ship> shortly."
units.italian: "Davvero? La descrizione sembrava utile per l'esplorazione, e aveva l'aria impegnativa." Il suo commlink cambia per mostrare l'ologramma di un hoverboarder che esegue un salto con uno sbuffo artistico di neve intorno. "Comunque, penso che questo viaggio sia un buon diversivo per entrambi. Ti raggiungo a bordo della <ship> tra poco."

units.english: vail fun
units.italian: vail fun

units.italian: "Eccellente. Ti raggiungo a bordo della <ship> tra poco."

units.italian: Mentre ti avvicini a Vail, i sensori specializzati del tuo Laboratorio di Ricerca dei Remnant rilevano parti della rete di controllo meteorologico incaricata di aumentare le nevicate sul pianeta. Il sistema di navigazione capta i radiofari che segnalano il percorso di avvicinamento, e in poco tempo vieni guidato automaticamente a una piazzola alla periferia dello spazioporto principale.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Visit to Paradise 1|	Looking outside the ship, you can see a multitude of tourist-oriented facilities overwhelming the normal spaceport functions. You can pick out a small sign off to the side that indicates professional commodity and banking facilities, but otherwise the area is dominated by businesses offering mountain touring, sports classes, and vehicle rentals. Next to you, Taely alternates between peering out at the signs and reading brochures on a new commlink. "Here, <first>. This one sounds more interested in providing a challenge and less pampering. What do you think?"|75|0
units.english: Looking outside the ship, you can see a multitude of tourist-oriented facilities overwhelming the normal spaceport functions. You can pick out a small sign off to the side that indicates professional commodity and banking facilities, but otherwise the area is dominated by businesses offering mountain touring, sports classes, and vehicle rentals. Next to you, Taely alternates between peering out at the signs and reading brochures on a new commlink. "Here, <first>. This one sounds more interested in providing a challenge and less pampering. What do you think?"
units.italian: Guardando fuori dalla nave, vedi una moltitudine di strutture per turisti che sovrastano le normali funzioni dello spazioporto. Riesci a distinguere un piccolo cartello di lato che indica strutture professionali per merci e servizi bancari, ma per il resto l'area è dominata da attività che offrono escursioni in montagna, corsi sportivi e noleggio di veicoli. Accanto a te, Taely alterna occhiate ai cartelli e lettura di opuscoli su un nuovo commlink. "Ecco, <first>. Questo sembra più interessato a offrire una sfida e meno a coccolare. Che ne pensi?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Visit to Paradise 1|	"Looks good to me."|77|0
units.english: "Looks good to me."
units.italian: "Per me va bene."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Visit to Paradise 1|	"Alright, should be good."|78|0
units.english: "Alright, should be good."
units.italian: "D'accordo, dovrebbe andare."

units.english: The resort in question is a more exclusive facility, and is located away from the main train lines. You rent a hovercar from one of the rental companies and make the short trek out to the resort. The rest of the day is spent out on the slopes, where both you and Taely eventually develop sufficient skill to graduate from the easy runs up to the medium difficulty. You both fall repeatedly, but Taely's good humor is contagious as she takes the inevitable facefuls of snow in stride.
units.italian: Il resort in questione è una struttura più esclusiva, lontana dalle linee ferroviarie principali. Noleggi un hovercar da una delle compagnie di noleggio e fai il breve tragitto fino al resort. Il resto della giornata passa sulle piste, dove sia tu sia Taely alla fine sviluppate abbastanza tecnica da passare dalle discese facili a quelle di media difficoltà. Cadete ripetutamente entrambi, ma il buonumore di Taely è contagioso mentre incassa i suoi inevitabili musetti pieni di neve.

You rent a hovercar from one of the rental companies and make the short trek out to the resort. The rest of the day is spent out on the slopes, where you teach Taely the basics of hoverboarding. Taely cade un paio di volte, ma prende le sue cadute con buonumore, e non sembra mai fare due volte lo stesso errore.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Visit to Paradise 1|	Heading back to the spaceport after a day of hoverboarding, Taely surprises you by pulling the hood open on the hovercar and spending almost an hour going over the internal systems before closing it up with a nod. "Well, that was interesting. The hovercar, I mean." She gestures at it with her commlink. "So many different manufacturers were involved in making this vehicle. Sometimes I wonder if humanity appreciates the luxury such diversity affords them." She looks thoughtful, then gestures toward the ship. "Well, <first>, I promised you a tour of a historic Remnant district. Caelian has perhaps the best example of one, so I would recommend we go there."|86|0
units.english: Heading back to the spaceport after a day of hoverboarding, Taely surprises you by pulling the hood open on the hovercar and spending almost an hour going over the internal systems before closing it up with a nod. "Well, that was interesting. The hovercar, I mean." She gestures at it with her commlink. "So many different manufacturers were involved in making this vehicle. Sometimes I wonder if humanity appreciates the luxury such diversity affords them." She looks thoughtful, then gestures toward the ship. "Well, <first>, I promised you a tour of a historic Remnant district. Caelian has perhaps the best example of one, so I would recommend we go there."
units.italian: Tornando allo spazioporto dopo una giornata di hoverboard, Taely ti sorprende aprendo il cofano dell'hovercar e passando quasi un'ora sui sistemi interni prima di richiuderlo con un cenno. "Beh, è stato interessante. L'hovercar, intendo." Gesticola verso il veicolo con il commlink. "Tantissimi produttori diversi hanno partecipato alla costruzione di questo veicolo. A volte mi chiedo se l'umanità apprezzi il lusso che una tale diversità le concede." Resta pensierosa, poi gesticola verso la nave. "Bene, <first>, ti avevo promesso un giro in un quartiere storico dei Remnant. Caelian ne ha forse l'esempio migliore, quindi consiglierei di andare lì."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Visit to Paradise 1|Taely directs you to a landing pad on the outskirts of the main spaceport, in an area that seems mostly filled with Gulls and Pelicans shifting larger quantities of products. Disembarking from the <ship>, she leads you down a large series of escalators that branch off in several directions, occasionally connecting with large ramps filled with steady streams of cargo traffic. After a few minutes they deposit you on a large platform.|89|0
units.english: Taely directs you to a landing pad on the outskirts of the main spaceport, in an area that seems mostly filled with Gulls and Pelicans shifting larger quantities of products. Disembarking from the <ship>, she leads you down a large series of escalators that branch off in several directions, occasionally connecting with large ramps filled with steady streams of cargo traffic. After a few minutes they deposit you on a large platform.
units.italian: Taely ti indirizza a una piazzola alla periferia dello spazioporto principale, in un'area che sembra piena soprattutto di Gull e Pelican che spostano grandi quantità di prodotti. Sbarcando dalla <ship>, ti guida giù per una lunga serie di scale mobili che si diramano in più direzioni, collegandosi ogni tanto a grandi rampe piene di un flusso costante di traffico merci. Dopo qualche minuto ti depositano su una grande piattaforma.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Visit to Paradise 1|	Approaching the edge of the platform, Taely puts out her arm to stop you from advancing any farther. "Watch out for the barrier," she says as she puts a hand out and touches something in mid-air in front of you. As she leans on it you can see faint ripples around her hand. "They are an essential safety feature, but they can still hurt if you run into them." She gestures to easily recognizable hazard markings on the floor. "With time you will learn to notice the faint shield ripples in the air, but meanwhile, just remember that anywhere that has the 'stand-back' lines on the floor likely has shields above it most of the time."|90|0
units.english: Approaching the edge of the platform, Taely puts out her arm to stop you from advancing any farther. "Watch out for the barrier," she says as she puts a hand out and touches something in mid-air in front of you. As she leans on it you can see faint ripples around her hand. "They are an essential safety feature, but they can still hurt if you run into them." She gestures to easily recognizable hazard markings on the floor. "With time you will learn to notice the faint shield ripples in the air, but meanwhile, just remember that anywhere that has the 'stand-back' lines on the floor likely has shields above it most of the time."
units.italian: Avvicinandoti al bordo della piattaforma, Taely stende il braccio per fermarti. "Attento alla barriera," dice mentre allunga una mano e tocca qualcosa a mezz'aria davanti a te. Mentre si appoggia, vedi leggere increspature intorno alla sua mano. "Sono un dispositivo di sicurezza essenziale, ma possono comunque fare male se ci corri contro." Gesticola verso segnali di pericolo ben riconoscibili sul pavimento. "Con il tempo imparerai a notare le deboli increspature degli scudi nell'aria, ma nel frattempo ricorda solo che ovunque ci siano le linee di 'non oltrepassare' sul pavimento, molto probabilmente ci sono scudi sopra."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Visit to Paradise 1|	Moments later, you see why the barriers are in place as a large train whooshes into the station at high speed before quickly coming to a stop. The barrier vanishes, and Taely leads you onto the train. Looking up and down the length of it, you can see hundreds, maybe even thousands of Remnant entering and exiting the train. Within moments the doors close, and the train starts moving again as you are pressed back into your seat. You see a few lights flicker past outside the window, but soon there is nothing outside but a monotonous dark blur.|91|0
units.english: Moments later, you see why the barriers are in place as a large train whooshes into the station at high speed before quickly coming to a stop. The barrier vanishes, and Taely leads you onto the train. Looking up and down the length of it, you can see hundreds, maybe even thousands of Remnant entering and exiting the train. Within moments the doors close, and the train starts moving again as you are pressed back into your seat. You see a few lights flicker past outside the window, but soon there is nothing outside but a monotonous dark blur.
units.italian: Pochi istanti dopo vedi perché le barriere ci sono: un grande treno sfreccia nella stazione ad alta velocità prima di fermarsi in fretta. La barriera svanisce, e Taely ti guida sul treno. Guardando su e giù per la sua lunghezza, vedi centinaia, forse migliaia di Remnant che entrano ed escono dal treno. In pochi istanti le porte si chiudono, e il treno riparte mentre vieni spinto contro il sedile. Vedi qualche luce sfrecciare fuori dal finestrino, ma presto fuori non c'è altro che una monotona macchia scura.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Visit to Paradise 1|	Taely notices your gaze. "Sorry, but there will not be much to see out there. The entire train line is quite far underground. Far enough to simply pass under terrain obstacles like rivers, valleys, or chasms." She nods to herself in satisfaction. "This will not be a long trip: we will only spend a few minutes at top speed before we start decelerating near our destination. I would recommend buckling into the harness."|92|0
units.english: Taely notices your gaze. "Sorry, but there will not be much to see out there. The entire train line is quite far underground. Far enough to simply pass under terrain obstacles like rivers, valleys, or chasms." She nods to herself in satisfaction. "This will not be a long trip: we will only spend a few minutes at top speed before we start decelerating near our destination. I would recommend buckling into the harness."
units.italian: Taely nota il tuo sguardo. "Scusa, ma là fuori non ci sarà molto da vedere. L'intera linea ferroviaria è molto in profondità. Abbastanza da passare semplicemente sotto ostacoli naturali come fiumi, valli o abissi." Annuisce a se stessa soddisfatta. "Non sarà un viaggio lungo: passeremo solo qualche minuto alla massima velocità prima di cominciare a decelerare vicino alla destinazione. Ti consiglierei di allacciarti al tirante."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Visit to Paradise 1|	"I am looking forward to seeing where we are going."|94|0
units.english: "I am looking forward to seeing where we are going."
units.italian: "Non vedo l'ora di vedere dove andiamo."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Visit to Paradise 1|	"How fast does this go?"|96|0
units.english: "How fast does this go?"
units.italian: "Quanto va veloce?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Visit to Paradise 1|	"The C3-L0 Maglev has a maximum rated velocity of 11D.E78 meters per second, and can sustain that almost indefinitely so long as the track remains powered. In practice, it rarely maintains that velocity for more than a few minutes at a time, as it is a local transport train. We do have some that go faster, but the amount of acceleration required to make use of them on short tracks is not terribly practical." She looks wistful. "Many people are working on solving the inertia problem, but Embers only know when that will result in something practical."|97|0
units.english: "The C3-L0 Maglev has a maximum rated velocity of 11D.E78 meters per second, and can sustain that almost indefinitely so long as the track remains powered. In practice, it rarely maintains that velocity for more than a few minutes at a time, as it is a local transport train. We do have some that go faster, but the amount of acceleration required to make use of them on short tracks is not terribly practical." She looks wistful. "Many people are working on solving the inertia problem, but Embers only know when that will result in something practical."
units.italian: "Il C3-L0 Maglev ha una velocità massima nominale di 11D.E78 metri al secondo, e può mantenerla quasi indefinitamente finché la linea resta alimentata. In pratica, raramente mantiene quella velocità per più di qualche minuto alla volta, dato che è un treno di trasporto locale. Ne abbiamo alcuni più veloci, ma l'accelerazione necessaria per usarli su tratte brevi non è molto pratica." Sembra nostalgica. "Molti stanno lavorando per risolvere il problema dell'inerzia, ma le Braci sanno quando questo porterà a qualcosa di pratico."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Visit to Paradise 1|	"Interesting. How long until we arrive?"|99|0
units.english: "Interesting. How long until we arrive?"
units.italian: "Interessante. Quanto manca all'arrivo?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Visit to Paradise 1|	"Why is that number so precise?"|101|0
units.english: "Why is that number so precise?"
units.italian: "Perché quel numero è così preciso?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Visit to Paradise 1|	"That sounds like the speed of light."|102|0
units.english: "That sounds like the speed of light."
units.italian: "Mi sembra la velocità della luce."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Visit to Paradise 1|	Taely smiles. "After all the safety factors, margins for error, and assorted other adjustments were taken into account, someone noticed that, when expressed in scientific notation, the coefficient of the rated value was calculated to be 1.1DE79, a fraction above the coefficient of the speed of light in a vacuum, so they adjusted the rated maximum velocity down only slightly so that they would match."|103|0
units.english: Taely smiles. "After all the safety factors, margins for error, and assorted other adjustments were taken into account, someone noticed that, when expressed in scientific notation, the coefficient of the rated value was calculated to be 1.1DE79, a fraction above the coefficient of the speed of light in a vacuum, so they adjusted the rated maximum velocity down only slightly so that they would match."
units.italian: Taely sorride. "Dopo aver tenuto conto di tutti i fattori di sicurezza, i margini di errore e varie altre correzioni, qualcuno notò che, espressa in notazione scientifica, il coefficiente del valore nominale risultava calcolato pari a 1.1DE79, una frazione sopra il coefficiente della velocità della luce nel vuoto, così ridussero la velocità massima nominale soltanto di poco perché coincidessero."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Visit to Paradise 1|	"Thanks for the explanation."|105|0
units.english: "Thanks for the explanation."
units.italian: "Grazie della spiegazione."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Visit to Paradise 1|	"What is a coefficient?"|107|0
units.english: "What is a coefficient?"
units.italian: "Che cos'è un coefficiente?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Visit to Paradise 1|	"What is scientific notation?"|108|0
units.english: "What is scientific notation?"
units.italian: "Che cos'è la notazione scientifica?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Visit to Paradise 1|	"Here, I will switch to base 10 to make it easier for you to understand." She pulls up a hologram with 299,792,458 m/s on it. As she speaks, the number shifts to 2.99792458x10^8 m/s. "When we write out a number such as the speed of light, it is typical to break it into parts. This is generally referred to as scientific notation. This is done to facilitate comparing and working with large numbers. The first part, 2.99792458 in this case, would be called the coefficient. The second part, x10, is called the base; and the third part, ^8 is the exponent." The display shifts again to show 1.1DE784Ax10^7 m/s. "So this would be how we typically write the speed of light when we are using it in our research. So, 1.1DE78 is the coefficient of both the speed of light and the speed of the train, just with a different exponent." She pauses, then vanishes the display. "We will be arriving momentarily, so I should probably stop there."|109|0
units.english: "Here, I will switch to base 10 to make it easier for you to understand." She pulls up a hologram with 299,792,458 m/s on it. As she speaks, the number shifts to 2.99792458x10^8 m/s. "When we write out a number such as the speed of light, it is typical to break it into parts. This is generally referred to as scientific notation. This is done to facilitate comparing and working with large numbers. The first part, 2.99792458 in this case, would be called the coefficient. The second part, x10, is called the base; and the third part, ^8 is the exponent." The display shifts again to show 1.1DE784Ax10^7 m/s. "So this would be how we typically write the speed of light when we are using it in our research. So, 1.1DE78 is the coefficient of both the speed of light and the speed of the train, just with a different exponent." She pauses, then vanishes the display. "We will be arriving momentarily, so I should probably stop there."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Celebration 1|	The crowd you have joined merges with other flows of people as you all stream onward, eventually emerging from the typical hallways into a massive cave. On one side, a large opening, framed by rough stone and a handful of shield emitters, looks up towards the night sky. Stalagmites with matching stalactites above them ring the perimeter of the room, but there is no sound of drips or traces of lingering moisture here. While the walls are still rough, natural stone, the floor and all the stalagmites have been polished smooth. With a quick glance, you estimate that there are already over a hundred people in here, and more are still filtering in around you and through several other doors. Taely leads you through the crowd, frequently gesturing greetings to those she passes by.|196|0
units.english: The crowd you have joined merges with other flows of people as you all stream onward, eventually emerging from the typical hallways into a massive cave. On one side, a large opening, framed by rough stone and a handful of shield emitters, looks up towards the night sky. Stalagmites with matching stalactites above them ring the perimeter of the room, but there is no sound of drips or traces of lingering moisture here. units.italian: La folla a cui vi siete uniti si fonde con altri flussi di persone mentre avanzate tutti insieme, emergendo alla fine dai tipici corridoi in una caverna immensa. Da un lato, una grande apertura incorniciata da pietra grezza e da qualche emettitore di scudi guarda verso il cielo notturno. Stalagmiti con le corrispondenti stalattiti sopra delimitano il perimetro della sala, ma qui non si sente alcuno stillicidio né traccia di umidità residua. Mentre le pareti sono ancora pietra naturale e grezza, il pavimento e tutte le stalagmiti sono stati levigati. Con un'occhiata rapida calcoli che ci sono già più di cento persone, e altre stanno ancora affluendo intorno a voi e da diverse altre porte. Taely ti guida tra la folla, salutando spesso con un gesto chi incontra.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Celebration 1|	Taely gestures quietly to you. "We start with the ritual query and response asking if we are safe. Safe in this moment, at least."|197|0
units.english: Taely gestures quietly to you. "We start with the ritual query and response asking if we are safe. Safe in this moment, at least."
units.italian: Taely ti gesticola piano. "Cominciamo con la domanda e la risposta rituale che chiede se siamo al sicuro. Al sicuro in questo momento, almeno."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Celebration 1|	Without warning the room stills, and all the doors close. units.english: Without warning the room stills, and all the doors close. A flurry of gestures washes out from the center of the room, as if everyone is repeating what someone has said, but you cannot see anyone starting it. units.italian: Senza preavviso la sala si ferma, e tutte le porte si chiudono. Un turbine di gesti si diffonde dal centro della stanza, come se tutti ripetessero quello che qualcuno ha detto, ma non riesci a vedere chi l'ha iniziato. "Perimetro sicuro?" arriva la domanda a gesti, seguita da un'onda di risposta dai bordi della sala verso il centro: "Tutto libero."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Celebration 1|	Suddenly, you become aware of a drum beat building in the silence, and then realize that it had already started with the first ripple of gestures, so quiet that, until now, it was unnoticeable. The beat builds gradually: a slow, steady rhythm.|201|0

units.italian: Guardandoti intorno nella sala vedi che la gente comincia a muoversi a tempo con il battito. Alcuni ondeggiano, altri annuiscono o battono i piedi. Accanto a te, Taely tiene una mano sul cuore e la tamburella piano. Presto senti altri percussionisti unirsi mentre il battito risuona in tutta la sala. Ora le persone non si limitano a ondeggiare a tempo, ma danzano. Alcune girano su se stesse, altre si dondolano avanti e indietro tra posizioni diverse, e alcune si sono prese per mano e hanno cominciato a muoversi in cerchio. Ovunque guardi ci sono persone che danzano in infinite varianti.

units.english: On the final word the chant ends and dozens of deep voices join together in a roaring crescendo before fading away, replaced by many new voices expressing tones of wonder. units.italian: Sull'ultima parola il canto finisce e decine di voci profonde si uniscono in un crescendo ruggente prima di dissolversi, sostituite da molte voci nuove che esprimono toni di meraviglia. A questo punto sembra che quasi ogni singola persona nella sala stia tamburellando, danzando o cantando - molti sembrano fare più cose contemporaneamente.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Celebration 1|	As the stars wheel through the night sky above the mouth of the cave, you note the flow of the ceremony seems to be telling a story of some kind. units.english: As the stars wheel through the night sky above the mouth of the cave, you note the flow of the ceremony seems to be telling a story of some kind. You understand very few snippets of words, but the emotion conveyed in the singing is clear. The early tone of anticipation shifts to the roar of excitement and then on to a peaceful tone of wonder.
units.italian: Mentre le stelle ruotano nel cielo notturno sopra l'imboccatura della caverna, noti che il flusso della cerimonia sembra raccontare una storia di qualche tipo. Capisci pochissimi frammenti di parole, ma l'emozione trasmessa dal canto è chiara. Il tono iniziale di attesa passa al ruggito dell'eccitazione e poi a un tono pacato di meraviglia.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Celebration 1|	As the ceremony continues, this shifts again to a steady, almost mechanical feel, which is in turn abruptly penetrated by a piercing thread of excitement, leading to the entire tone of the song becoming one of curiosity over another driving beat. The melody then seems to wander more, caught in dual tones of regret and anticipation, mourning and rejoicing, terror and hope, disorder and structure, disappointment and awe, and countless other deeply emotional pairings before finally culminating in a return to the original, unified heartbeat as the singers' voices come together, reaching upwards in hope before finally everything trails off into silence.|238|0
units.english: As the ceremony continues, this shifts again to a steady, almost mechanical feel, which is in turn abruptly penetrated by a piercing thread of excitement, leading to the entire tone of the song becoming one of curiosity over another driving beat. The melody then seems to wander more, caught in dual tones of regret and anticipation, mourning and rejoicing, terror and hope, disorder and structure, disappointment and awe, and countless other deeply emotional pairings before finally culminating in a return to the original, unified heartbeat as the singers' voices come together, reaching upwards in hope before finally everything trails off into silence.
units.italian: Mentre la cerimonia continua, il tono cambia di nuovo in una sensazione stabile, quasi meccanica, che viene poi improvvisamente trapassata da un filo acuto di eccitazione, portando l'intero tono del canto a farsi curiosità sopra un altro battito travolgente. La melodia sembra poi vagare di più, presa in toni duplici di rimpianto e attesa, lutto e gioia, terrore e speranza, disordine e struttura, delusione e soggezione, e innumerevoli altre coppie profondamente emotive, prima di culminare infine in un ritorno al battito originale e unificato mentre le voci dei cantori si uniscono, protendendosi verso l'alto nella speranza, prima che tutto si perda nel silenzio.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Celebration 1|	Through it all, Taely offers a running commentary on how each stretch of the ceremony represents a different piece of their collective history, ranging from the launch of the first human into space to its commercialization and then the new age of exploration opened by the advent of hyperdrives. It also includes numerous conflicts, disasters, and wars. Much of it is rather familiar to you from what you know of human history, but the later part is strange and unfamiliar. Filled with stories of first contact, strange ruins, alien invasions, desperate last stands, and brilliant discoveries, you are left with the impression that, despite the Remnant's current security, they have been on the precipice of extinction for much of their existence.|239|0
units.english: Through it all, Taely offers a running commentary on how each stretch of the ceremony represents a different piece of their collective history, ranging from the launch of the first human into space to its commercialization and then the new age of exploration opened by the advent of hyperdrives. It also includes numerous conflicts, disasters, and wars. Much of it is rather familiar to you from what you know of human history, but the later part is strange and unfamiliar. Filled with stories of first contact, strange ruins, alien invasions, desperate last stands, and brilliant discoveries, you are left with the impression that, despite the Remnant's current security, they have been on the precipice of extinction for much of their existence.
units.italian: Per tutto il tempo, Taely offre un commento continuo su come ogni parte della cerimonia rappresenti un pezzo diverso della loro storia collettiva, dal lancio del primo essere umano nello spazio alla sua commercializzazione, fino alla nuova era di esplorazione aperta dall'avvento degli iperpropulsori. Include anche numerosi conflitti, disastri e guerre. Molto ti è piuttosto familiare da quello che sai della storia umana, ma la parte successiva è strana e sconosciuta. Piena di storie di primi contatti, rovine misteriose, invasioni aliene, disperate ultime resistenze e scoperte brillanti, ti lascia l'impressione che, nonostante l'attuale sicurezza dei Remnant, per gran parte della loro esistenza siano stati sull'orlo dell'estinzione.

units.italian: Intorno a te tutti si sono fermati. La maggior parte sembra esausta, e alcuni sono seduti a terra o appoggiati alle pareti. Alcune persone sembrano aver pianto, e chi è loro vicino le abbraccia o semplicemente le tocca sulla spalla. La maggior parte delle persone che vedi ha espressioni riverenti e gioiose. Dopo che il silenzio si è protratto per quello che sembra un paio di minuti, le porte si aprono e la gente comincia a uscire. In breve la caverna è quasi vuota.

units.english: Taely smiles at that. "Well, it is and it is not. We hold these several times a month, though most people take part in only one every few weeks. Most of us have attended hundreds of these. Although as far as that goes, every one of these celebrations is different. Each person's participation and style is entirely up to them, so the details and feel of the group celebration as a whole are unique every time." After explaining this, she makes a singular gesture you have come to realize encompasses the idea, "If you have more questions, ask them."
units.italian: Taely sorride a questo. "Beh, lo è e non lo è. Ne teniamo diverse al mese, anche se la maggior parte delle persone partecipa solo a una ogni qualche settimana. Molti di noi ne hanno seguite centinaia. Però, a questo proposito, ogni celebrazione è diversa. La partecipazione e lo stile di ognuno sono del tutto personali, quindi i dettagli e la sensazione della celebrazione collettiva nel suo insieme sono unici ogni volta." Dopo aver spiegato questo, fa un singolo gesto che hai imparato a riconoscere come comprensivo dell'idea: "Se hai altre domande, falle."

units.english: Taely's gestures take on a tone of conviction. "For something like this, or anything of a social or spiritual nature for that matter, we determine who takes the lead for various parts at the moment, based on who is present. Whether we are talking about our connection with society, or our connection to the Universe, we must each forge our own understanding of it. units.italian: I gesti di Taely prendono un tono di convinzione. "Per qualcosa come questo, o per qualsiasi cosa di natura sociale o spirituale, stabiliamo sul momento chi guida le varie parti, in base a chi è presente. Che si tratti del nostro legame con la società o del nostro legame con l'Universo, ognuno deve forgiarne la propria comprensione. Perciò, quando ci riuniamo per cerimonie come questa, praticamente chiunque può essere scelto per guidare uno dei segmenti.

units.english: "As a result, each celebration takes on a different feel - after all, each of us has our own unique perspective, and bring our own experiences to contribute." She pauses, and adopts a respectful tone. "The ceremony is not just about major events, either. Everyone who takes part brings their own life experiences and memories to the story we tell. Memories of friends and family who are no longer with us are common as well."
units.italian: "Di conseguenza ogni celebrazione assume una sensazione diversa: dopotutto ognuno di noi ha la propria prospettiva unica e porta il proprio vissuto come contributo." Chiunque vi prenda parte porta le proprie esperienze di vita e i propri ricordi nella storia che raccontiamo. Sono comuni anche i ricordi di amici e familiari che non sono più con noi."
