units.english: Taely scowls a bit at this. "Only those guilty of the most serious crimes cannot stand as a lead." She pauses, and continues with an amused tone. "Even children take the lead now and then, usually with a parent or sibling to guide them." She smiles at that, then gestures for you to continue asking your questions.
units.italian: Taely fa una leggera smorfia. "Solo chi è colpevole dei reati più gravi non può essere guida." Si ferma e continua con tono divertito. "Persino i bambini guidano ogni tanto, di solito con un genitore o un fratello a guidarli." Sorride, poi gesticola perché tu continui a fare domande.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Celebration 1|label|300|0
units.english: celebration crime
units.italian: celebration crime

units.id: mission:Remnant: Celebration 1|	Taely gestures harshly. "Crimes against society, of course. Acting against the best interest of our collective well-being is the single most destructive and senseless act someone can perpetrate."|303|0
units.english: Taely gestures harshly. "Crimes against society, of course. Acting against the best interest of our collective well-being is the single most destructive and senseless act someone can perpetrate."
units.italian: Taely gesticola con durezza. "I reati contro la società, naturalmente. Agire contro il miglior interesse del nostro benessere collettivo è l'atto più distruttivo e insensato che qualcuno possa compiere."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Celebration 1|label|305|0
units.english: ask crying
units.italian: ask crying

units.id: mission:Remnant: Celebration 1|	Taely gestures gently. "Many were friends of the crew of a ship that was recently destroyed while studying a black hole. They acquired ground-breaking data from it, but perished in the process. Their friends and families are proud of them, of course, but that does not change the fact that they are lost to us mortals. Sometimes the whole experience is simply overwhelming, and some of us still sorrow for other losses in our stories."|312|0
units.english: Taely gestures gently. "Many were friends of the crew of a ship that was recently destroyed while studying a black hole. They acquired ground-breaking data from it, but perished in the process. Their friends and families are proud of them, of course, but that does not change the fact that they are lost to us mortals. Sometimes the whole experience is simply overwhelming, and some of us still sorrow for other losses in our stories."
units.italian: Taely gesticola con delicatezza. "Molti erano amici dell'equipaggio di una nave distrutta di recente mentre studiava un buco nero. Ne avevano ottenuto dati rivoluzionari, ma sono periti nel tentativo. I loro amici e le loro famiglie sono orgogliosi di loro, certo, ma questo non cambia il fatto che li abbiamo persi, noi mortali. A volte l'esperienza nel suo insieme è semplicemente travolgente, e alcuni di noi portano ancora il lutto per altre perdite nelle proprie storie."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Celebration 1|	Taely nods in agreement and simply gestures expansively at the cavern around you, giving you a few moments to contemplate it. Eventually she gestures asking if you have any further questions.|321|0
units.english: Taely nods in agreement and simply gestures expansively at the cavern around you, giving you a few moments to contemplate it. Eventually she gestures asking if you have any further questions.
units.italian: Taely annuisce d'accordo e gesticola semplicemente in modo ampio verso la caverna intorno a te, concedendoti qualche momento per contemplarla. Alla fine gesticola chiedendoti se hai altre domande.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Celebration 1|label|323|0
units.english: celebration request
units.italian: celebration request

units.id: mission:Remnant: Celebration 1|	Taely strides over to a console near the closest door and retrieves a crystal from a compartment within. She slips it into a case and turns back to you. "Our celebrations are something that bind us together, and we share in both the memory of the departed and the hope for the future. As such, we keep recordings of them so that those who are not present at a particular event may still experience it too. This recording is destined for those working in Postverta, as a friend of one of those being mourned today is stationed there. Could you deliver this to them please?"|324|0
units.english: Taely strides over to a console near the closest door and retrieves a crystal from a compartment within. She slips it into a case and turns back to you. "Our celebrations are something that bind us together, and we share in both the memory of the departed and the hope for the future. As such, we keep recordings of them so that those who are not present at a particular event may still experience it too. This recording is destined for those working in Postverta, as a friend of one of those being mourned today is stationed there. Could you deliver this to them please?"
units.italian: Taely va a passo svelto verso una console vicino alla porta più vicina e preleva un cristallo da uno scomparto. Lo infila in una custodia e si volta verso di te. "Le nostre celebrazioni sono qualcosa che ci tiene uniti, e condividiamo sia il ricordo di chi è andato via sia la speranza nel futuro. Perciò ne conserviamo le registrazioni, così che chi non è presente a un evento particolare possa comunque viverlo. Questa registrazione è destinata a chi lavora a Postverta, perché lì è di stanza un amico di una delle persone che oggi abbiamo ricordato. Potresti consegnargliela, per favore?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Celebration 1|	"Yes."|328|0
units.english: "Yes."
units.italian: "Sì."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Celebration 1|	"Sorry, I'm not headed that way."|330|0
units.english: "Sorry, I'm not headed that way."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, non vado in quella direzione."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Celebration 1|	She looks disappointed, but merely shrugs and pockets the crystal. "I will find someone else to transport this, then."|331|0
units.english: She looks disappointed, but merely shrugs and pockets the crystal. "I will find someone else to transport this, then."
units.italian: Sembra delusa, ma si limita ad alzare le spalle e a mettere il cristallo in tasca. "Troverò qualcun altro per trasportarlo, allora."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Celebration 1|When you arrive on Postverta there is a small group of Remnant waiting at the landing bay for you. As you hand the crystal to one, another gestures, "Thank you for bringing this to us, Captain <first>. Being able to join in the Remembrance will help me to celebrate those who have gone on before." The group heads off into the depths of the station, leaving you in the bay.|336|0
units.english: When you arrive on Postverta there is a small group of Remnant waiting at the landing bay for you. As you hand the crystal to one, another gestures, "Thank you for bringing this to us, Captain <first>. Being able to join in the Remembrance will help me to celebrate those who have gone on before." The group heads off into the depths of the station, leaving you in the bay.
units.italian: Quando arrivi su Postverta c'è un piccolo gruppo di Remnant che ti aspetta nella baia di atterraggio. Mentre consegni il cristallo a uno di loro, un altro gesticola: "Grazie per avercelo portato, capitano <first>. Poter partecipare al Ricordo mi aiuterà a celebrare chi è andato avanti prima di noi." Il gruppo si dirige verso le profondità della stazione, lasciandoti nella baia.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Celebration 1|	Taely never mentioned anything about compensation, but as soon as the Remnant leave, your commlink notifies you that you have been assigned <payment>.|337|0
units.english: Taely never mentioned anything about compensation, but as soon as the Remnant leave, your commlink notifies you that you have been assigned <payment>.
units.italian: Taely non ha mai parlato di compensi, ma appena i Remnant se ne vanno il tuo commlink ti avvisa che ti è stato assegnato <payment>.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Teciimach Deployment|name|345|0
units.english: New EMP deployment
units.italian: Nuovo schieramento EMP

units.id: mission:Remnant: Teciimach Deployment|description|346|0
units.english: The Remnant are deploying a new version of the EMP, and invite you to watch.
units.italian: I Remnant stanno schierando una nuova versione dell'EMP e ti invitano a guardare.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Teciimach Deployment|You note a disturbance in the shipyards before the <ship> even touches the ground. Every pad is filled with ships, camels pulling wagon trains loaded with canisters trundle out of the outfitter, and technicians clamber everywhere. As you step out of your ship, Taely slides down the side of a Merganser resting next to you.|357|0
units.english: You note a disturbance in the shipyards before the <ship> even touches the ground. Every pad is filled with ships, camels pulling wagon trains loaded with canisters trundle out of the outfitter, and technicians clamber everywhere. As you step out of your ship, Taely slides down the side of a Merganser resting next to you.
units.italian: Noti un trambusto nei cantieri navali ancor prima che la <ship> tocchi terra. Ogni piazzola è piena di navi, cammelli che trainano carovane cariche di taniche escono dal fornitore di equipaggiamento, e i tecnici si arrampicano ovunque. Mentre scendi dalla nave, Taely scivola lungo il fianco di un Merganser che riposa accanto a te.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Teciimach Deployment|	"Good timing, Captain! We just rolled out an upgrade to some of our oldest equipment, and our Mergansers finally have something to carry as first-strike weapons. Interested in taking a look?"|358|0
units.english: "Good timing, Captain! We just rolled out an upgrade to some of our oldest equipment, and our Mergansers finally have something to carry as first-strike weapons. Interested in taking a look?"
units.italian: "Bel tempismo, capitano! Abbiamo appena rilasciato un aggiornamento ad alcune delle nostre apparecchiature più vecchie, e i nostri Merganser hanno finalmente qualcosa da portare come arma di primo colpo. Ti interessa dare un'occhiata?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Teciimach Deployment|	"Yes."|360|0
units.english: "Yes."
units.italian: "Sì."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Teciimach Deployment|	"Sorry, but I'm a bit busy at the moment."|361|0
units.english: "Sorry, but I'm a bit busy at the moment."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, ma al momento sono un po' occupato."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Teciimach Deployment|	She turns and heads towards a nearby lift where another crew of Remnant had just moved several EMP Torpedo canisters into place. "Well, you have probably seen us use EMP Torpedoes now and then, right? Well, as you probably noticed, they have a few tactical issues. They are slow, they often hit our ships almost as much as our targets, and they take up space we could otherwise be using for more important things like laboratories or scanners." She taps a few commands into the console, and the lift begins raising the canisters towards the waiting ship.|363|0
units.english: She turns and heads towards a nearby lift where another crew of Remnant had just moved several EMP Torpedo canisters into place. "Well, you have probably seen us use EMP Torpedoes now and then, right? Well, as you probably noticed, they have a few tactical issues. They are slow, they often hit our ships almost as much as our targets, and they take up space we could otherwise be using for more important things like laboratories or scanners." She taps a few commands into the console, and the lift begins raising the canisters towards the waiting ship.
units.italian: Si volta e si dirige verso un ascensore vicino, dove un'altra squadra di Remnant ha appena sistemato diverse taniche di siluri EMP. "Beh, ti sarà capitato di vederci usare i siluri EMP ogni tanto, vero? Come avrai notato, hanno qualche problema tattico. Sono lenti, spesso colpiscono le nostre navi quasi quanto i bersagli, e occupano spazio che potremmo usare per cose più importanti, come laboratori o scanner." Tocca qualche comando nella console, e l'ascensore comincia a sollevare le taniche verso la nave in attesa.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Teciimach Deployment|	"Over the past decades we have had a few teams working on improving them from different angles. Some focused on the torpedoes themselves, others focused on the launcher. The surprising development, however, was from a team working down in the Warren. They figured out a way to shave a few cubic meters off the systems that assemble the torpedoes, and compress the whole structure. We are still working on reducing production costs, but the results should be in the outfitter for you in the next day or two."|364|0
units.english: "Over the past decades we have had a few teams working on improving them from different angles. Some focused on the torpedoes themselves, others focused on the launcher. The surprising development, however, was from a team working down in the Warren. They figured out a way to shave a few cubic meters off the systems that assemble the torpedoes, and compress the whole structure. We are still working on reducing production costs, but the results should be in the outfitter for you in the next day or two."
units.italian: "Negli ultimi decenni abbiamo avuto diverse squadre che lavoravano per migliorarli da angolazioni diverse. Alcune si concentravano sui siluri stessi, altre sul lanciatore. Lo sviluppo sorprendente, però, è venuto da una squadra che lavora giù nella Tana. Hanno trovato il modo di risparmiare qualche metro cubo nei sistemi che assemblano i siluri, comprimendo l'intera struttura. Stiamo ancora lavorando per ridurre i costi di produzione, ma i risultati dovrebbero essere nel fornitore di equipaggiamento entro un giorno o due."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Teciimach Deployment|	She looks at you and nods contemplatively. "One thing worth noting - you are making great strides in learning our language, so new items that appear in our outfitter will be listed under their proper name instead of substitutes from the ancestral tongue."|365|0
units.english: She looks at you and nods contemplatively. "One thing worth noting - you are making great strides in learning our language, so new items that appear in our outfitter will be listed under their proper name instead of substitutes from the ancestral tongue."
units.italian: Ti guarda e annuisce pensierosa. "Una cosa da notare: stai facendo grandi progressi nell'imparare la nostra lingua, quindi i nuovi oggetti che appariranno nel nostro fornitore saranno elencati con il loro nome proprio invece che con sostituti della lingua ancestrale."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Teciimach Deployment|	"Whatever makes things easier for everyone."|367|0
units.english: "Whatever makes things easier for everyone."
units.italian: "Tutto ciò che rende le cose più facili per tutti."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Teciimach Deployment|	"Thanks. What names were changed?"|369|0
units.english: "Thanks. What names were changed?"
units.italian: "Grazie. Quali nomi sono cambiati?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Teciimach Deployment|	She looks amused. "Mainly weapons. If something is named an adjective that describes what it does, then it was a name we made up on the spot to include in the linguistic overlay we put in place for the displays. We did that so that you would have an easier time understanding what something does. Thankfully, you no longer need such aides."|370|0
units.english: She looks amused. "Mainly weapons. If something is named an adjective that describes what it does, then it was a name we made up on the spot to include in the linguistic overlay we put in place for the displays. We did that so that you would have an easier time understanding what something does. Thankfully, you no longer need such aides."
units.italian: Sembra divertita. "Soprattutto armi. Se qualcosa ha il nome di un aggettivo che ne descrive la funzione, allora era un nome che abbiamo inventato sul momento per includerlo nella sovrapposizione linguistica che abbiamo messo sui display. Lo facemmo perché tu avessi più facilità a capire cosa fa una cosa. Per fortuna non hai più bisogno di questi aiuti."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Teciimach Deployment|	"Thanks for the explanation."|372|0
units.english: "Thanks for the explanation."
units.italian: "Grazie della spiegazione."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Teciimach Deployment|	"Thanks! Circling back to our earlier topic, what does 'Warren' mean?"|374|0
units.english: "Thanks! Circling back to our earlier topic, what does 'Warren' mean?"
units.italian: "Grazie! Tornando al discorso di prima, che cosa significa 'Tana'?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Teciimach Deployment|	"It is our term for the network of caves, tunnels, and spaces deep underground. All three of our main worlds have them in some form or another. We know a little about the original people who built them, but not nearly as much as we would like. They called themselves the Zitchal Maudrakoi, and one of the most distinguishing features we have been able to learn about them is that they do not seem to attach much importance to directionality. For example, in a control room we found, there were instruments and controls on every available surface, with just a scattering of handholds to support the operator." She shrugs. "Plume or Dusk would know more than I about them. I mostly focus on understanding their equipment."|375|0
units.english: "It is our term for the network of caves, tunnels, and spaces deep underground. All three of our main worlds have them in some form or another. We know a little about the original people who built them, but not nearly as much as we would like. They called themselves the Zitchal Maudrakoi, and one of the most distinguishing features we have been able to learn about them is that they do not seem to attach much importance to directionality. For example, in a control room we found, there were instruments and controls on every available surface, with just a scattering of handholds to support the operator." She shrugs. "Plume or Dusk would know more than I about them. I mostly focus on understanding their equipment."
units.italian: "È il nostro termine per la rete di caverne, gallerie e spazi in profondità nel sottosuolo. Tutti e tre i nostri mondi principali ne hanno, in una forma o nell'altra. Sappiamo qualcosa delle popolazioni originali che li costruirono, ma non quanto vorremmo. Si chiamavano Zitchal Maudrakoi, e una delle caratteristiche più distintive che siamo riusciti a scoprire è che non sembrano dare molta importanza alla direzionalità. Per esempio, in una sala di controllo che abbiamo trovato c'erano strumenti e comandi su ogni superficie disponibile, con solo qualche maniglia a supporto dell'operatore." Alza le spalle. "Plume o Dusk ne saprebbero più di me. Io mi concentro soprattutto sul capire le loro apparecchiature."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Teciimach Deployment|label|376|0
units.english: emp no
units.italian: emp no

units.id: mission:Remnant: Teciimach Deployment|	"Well, I should get back to work, then. Next time you are in space, take a look at how our ships fare in battle. Hopefully you will see an improvement." She grabs a couple components from a nearby lift, and scrambles back up the side of the Merganser to continue working on a new bay.|377|0
units.english: "Well, I should get back to work, then. Next time you are in space, take a look at how our ships fare in battle. Hopefully you will see an improvement." She grabs a couple components from a nearby lift, and scrambles back up the side of the Merganser to continue working on a new bay.
units.italian: "Beh, allora devo tornare al lavoro. La prossima volta che sei nello spazio, dai un'occhiata a come se la cavano le nostre navi in battaglia. Speriamo che tu veda un miglioramento." Prende un paio di componenti da un ascensore vicino e si arrampica di nuovo sul fianco del Merganser per continuare a lavorare a una nuova baia.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Teciimach Deployment|Now that the most recent Korath raiders have been defeated, you decide to check your sensor logs to see how the new EMP Torpedoes Taely talked about performed. You note that the EMP bursts no longer have an impact on friendly ships. This could make them much more versatile.|399|0
units.english: Now that the most recent Korath raiders have been defeated, you decide to check your sensor logs to see how the new EMP Torpedoes Taely talked about performed. You note that the EMP bursts no longer have an impact on friendly ships. This could make them much more versatile.
units.italian: Ora che gli ultimi predoni Korath sono stati sconfitti, decidi di controllare i registri dei sensori per vedere come si sono comportati i nuovi siluri EMP di cui parlava Taely. Noti che le esplosioni EMP non hanno più effetto sulle navi amiche. Questo potrebbe renderli molto più versatili.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Teciimach Deployment|You recall Taely mentioning something about new weaponry, so you decide to check your logs to see what your sensors have recorded lately. Looking over the most recent combat details, you note that the EMP bursts no longer have an impact on friendly ships. This could make them much more versatile.|402|0
units.english: You recall Taely mentioning something about new weaponry, so you decide to check your logs to see what your sensors have recorded lately. Looking over the most recent combat details, you note that the EMP bursts no longer have an impact on friendly ships. This could make them much more versatile.
units.italian: Ricordi che Taely aveva accennato a nuove armi, così decidi di controllare i registri per vedere cosa hanno rilevato i sensori di recente. Esaminando i dettagli dell'ultimo combattimento, noti che le esplosioni EMP non hanno più effetto sulle navi amiche. Questo potrebbe renderli molto più versatili.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Shattered Light 1|dialog|421|0
units.english: This ship barely registers on your sensors, and you can clearly see through it. The Remnant will want to know about it. You should probably look for Taely on Viminal.
units.italian: Questa nave appare a malapena sui tuoi sensori, e riesci a vederci attraverso. I Remnant vorranno saperlo. Probabilmente dovresti cercare Taely su Viminal.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Shattered Light 1|Looking around the Viminal spaceport, you spot Taely using something that slightly resembles a small catapult to launch a sizable rock across the cavern. A nearby Merganser leaps into the air and chases after it, pouncing on the rock and vanishing from sight before reappearing next to Taely, dropping it next to her. Without looking away from the Merganser she waves you over.|424|0
units.english: Looking around the Viminal spaceport, you spot Taely using something that slightly resembles a small catapult to launch a sizable rock across the cavern. A nearby Merganser leaps into the air and chases after it, pouncing on the rock and vanishing from sight before reappearing next to Taely, dropping it next to her. Without looking away from the Merganser she waves you over.
units.italian: Guardandoti intorno nello spazioporto di Viminal, vedi Taely che usa qualcosa di simile a un piccolo catapulta per lanciare un sasso considerevole attraverso la caverna. Un Merganser lì vicino balza in aria e lo insegue, saltandogli addosso e svanendo alla vista prima di riapparire accanto a Taely, dove lo lascia cadere. Senza distogliere lo sguardo dal Merganser ti fa cenno di avvicinarti.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Shattered Light 1|	"Well met, <first>, how goes your travels? Found anything interesting?"|425|0
units.english: "Well met, <first>, how goes your travels? Found anything interesting?"
units.italian: "Ben incontrato, <first>, come vanno i tuoi viaggi? Hai trovato qualcosa di interessante?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Shattered Light 1|	She listens to your description of the encounter with the ghostly ship whilst looking at the recording you pull up from your commlink. "This is very intriguing. I will need to consult a few people. If you are interested in investigating this, ensure your ship has a Research Laboratory installed, and meet me in the spaceport."|426|0
units.english: She listens to your description of the encounter with the ghostly ship whilst looking at the recording you pull up from your commlink. "This is very intriguing. I will need to consult a few people. If you are interested in investigating this, ensure your ship has a Research Laboratory installed, and meet me in the spaceport."
units.italian: Ti ascolta mentre descrivi l'incontro con la nave spettrale, guardando la registrazione che tiri su dal commlink. "È molto intrigante. Dovrò consultare alcune persone. Se ti interessa indagare, assicurati che la nave abbia installato un Laboratorio di Ricerca e incontrami allo spazioporto."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Shattered Light 2|name|431|0
units.english: Searching for Ghosts
units.italian: Caccia ai fantasmi

units.id: mission:Remnant: Shattered Light 2|description|432|0
units.english: Take Ruach to find and scan the ghostly ship.
units.italian: Porta Ruach a trovare e scansionare la nave spettrale.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Shattered Light 2|blocked|433|0
units.english: Your commlink chimes with a note that this mission requires a Research Laboratory installed on your flagship as well as 2 tons of cargo space and 1 free bunk.
units.italian: Il tuo commlink trilla con una nota che questa missione richiede un Laboratorio di Ricerca installato sulla tua nave ammiraglia, oltre a 2 tonnellate di spazio nel carico e 1 cuccetta libera.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Shattered Light 2|Your arrival in the spaceport finds Taely in deep conversation with an elderly Remnant, empty food trays cluttering the table before them. They both turn when you approach, breaking off their conversation.|443|0
units.english: Your arrival in the spaceport finds Taely in deep conversation with an elderly Remnant, empty food trays cluttering the table before them. They both turn when you approach, breaking off their conversation.
units.italian: Al tuo arrivo allo spazioporto trovi Taely in una profonda conversazione con un'anziana Remnant, con vassoi vuoti che affollano il tavolo davanti a loro. Si voltano entrambe quando ti avvicini, interrompendo il discorso.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Shattered Light 2|	"Thank you for coming, Captain <last>. I would like to introduce you to Ruach. She was a shipyard engineering prefect for many decades, but now spends most of her time as a teacher."|444|0
units.english: "Thank you for coming, Captain <last>. I would like to introduce you to Ruach. She was a shipyard engineering prefect for many decades, but now spends most of her time as a teacher."
units.italian: "Grazie per essere venuto, capitano <last>. Vorrei presentarti Ruach. È stata prefetto dell'ingegneria dei cantieri navali per molti decenni, ma ora passa la maggior parte del tempo come insegnante."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Shattered Light 2|	Ruach gives a polite bow. "Taely lays too many compliments on me," she gestures with amusement. "I fulfilled my duty doing the best with that which the Embers blessed me, nothing more, nothing less. But it has been rewarding watching someone take everything I taught them and fly with it to heights I could only dream of."|445|0
units.english: Ruach gives a polite bow. "Taely lays too many compliments on me," she gestures with amusement. "I fulfilled my duty doing the best with that which the Embers blessed me, nothing more, nothing less. But it has been rewarding watching someone take everything I taught them and fly with it to heights I could only dream of."
units.italian: Ruach fa un inchino cortese. "Taely mi riempie di complimenti," gesticola divertita. "Ho fatto il mio dovere dando il meglio con ciò che le Braci mi hanno donato, né più né meno. Ma è stato gratificante vedere qualcuno prendere tutto quello che gli ho insegnato e volare con esso ad altezze che potevo solo sognare."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Shattered Light 2|	Ruach's gestures take on a more precise cadence. "Taely tells me that you have spotted a strange 'ghost' in Caeculus that bears a resemblance to ancestral ships. Could you take me to do a scan of it please?"|446|0
units.english: Ruach's gestures take on a more precise cadence. "Taely tells me that you have spotted a strange 'ghost' in Caeculus that bears a resemblance to ancestral ships. Could you take me to do a scan of it please?"
units.italian: I gesti di Ruach prendono una cadenza più precisa. "Taely mi dice che hai avvistato uno strano 'fantasma' a Caeculus che somiglia alle navi ancestrali. Potresti portarmi a farne una scansione, per favore?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Shattered Light 2|	"Okay."|448|0
units.english: "Okay."
units.italian: "Va bene."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Shattered Light 2|	"Sorry, not interested."|450|0
units.english: "Sorry, not interested."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, non mi interessa."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Shattered Light 2|Ruach pores over the scanning arrays before reporting that the subject is not present. She suggests searching nearby systems to locate it.|454|0
units.english: Ruach pores over the scanning arrays before reporting that the subject is not present. She suggests searching nearby systems to locate it.
units.italian: Ruach si china sugli apparati di scansione prima di riferire che il soggetto non è presente. Suggerisce di cercare nei sistemi vicini per localizzarlo.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Shattered Light 2|dialog|460|0
units.english: This ship seems a bit more solid than it did when you first saw it, but it does not seem to be quite present.
units.italian: Questa nave sembra un po' più solida di quando l'hai vista la prima volta, ma non sembra del tutto presente.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Shattered Light 2|The <ship> hasn't even settled onto the landing pad when Ruach leaps down from the airlock and jogs a couple of spots down to stare up at the gills of an Albatross. A few moments later, Taely drops out of them, greeting Ruach warmly. By the time you join them, Ruach has a hologram of the spectral ship floating in the air. "It is lacking the confirmation codes or identification info, but I am confident that this is it," muses Ruach as you arrive.|464|0
units.english: The <ship> hasn't even settled onto the landing pad when Ruach leaps down from the airlock and jogs a couple of spots down to stare up at the gills of an Albatross. A few moments later, Taely drops out of them, greeting Ruach warmly. By the time you join them, Ruach has a hologram of the spectral ship floating in the air. "It is lacking the confirmation codes or identification info, but I am confident that this is it," muses Ruach as you arrive.
units.italian: La <ship> non si è ancora posata sulla piazzola che Ruach balza giù dalla camera di equilibrio e corre un paio di posti più in là per fissare le branchie di un Albatross. Pochi istanti dopo, Taely ne esce, salutando Ruach con calore. Quando le raggiungi, Ruach ha già un ologramma della nave spettrale sospeso nell'aria. "Mancano i codici di conferma e le informazioni di identificazione, ma sono certa che sia questa," mormora Ruach mentre arrivi.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Shattered Light 2|	"Sorry for leaving you behind, <first>, but this is just such an exciting discovery. This ship you found matches the profile of the Shattered Light - a large city ship that was part of the Exodus but never arrived on this side of the wormhole. There are so many questions to be answered! Anyway, the data is being distributed right now. Meet me in the cafeteria in a few hours to see what ideas have come up. Oh, and before I forget, we have allotted you <payment> for your assistance."|465|0
units.english: "Sorry for leaving you behind, <first>, but this is just such an exciting discovery. This ship you found matches the profile of the Shattered Light - a large city ship that was part of the Exodus but never arrived on this side of the wormhole. There are so many questions to be answered! Anyway, the data is being distributed right now. Meet me in the cafeteria in a few hours to see what ideas have come up. Oh, and before I forget, we have allotted you <payment> for your assistance."
units.italian: "Scusa se ti abbiamo lasciato indietro, <first>, ma è una scoperta così emozionante. Questa nave che hai trovato corrisponde al profilo della Shattered Light, una grande nave-città che faceva parte dell'Esodo ma non è mai arrivata da questo lato del cunicolo. Ci sono così tante domande a cui rispondere! Comunque, i dati sono in distribuzione proprio ora. Incontrami nella mensa tra qualche ora per vedere quali idee sono emerse. Oh, e prima che me lo dimentichi, ti abbiamo assegnato <payment> per il tuo aiuto."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Shattered Light 3|name|470|0
units.english: Ghost Touch
units.italian: Tocco fantasma

units.id: mission:Remnant: Shattered Light 3|description|471|0
units.english: Help the Remnant experiment on the Shattered Light.
units.italian: Aiuta i Remnant a sperimentare sulla Shattered Light.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Shattered Light 3|blocked|472|0
units.english: As you approach the starport your commlink chimes with a message from Ruach requesting that you make space for 13 people as well as 19 tons of cargo.
units.italian: Mentre ti avvicini allo spazioporto, il commlink trilla con un messaggio di Ruach che ti chiede di fare spazio per 13 persone e 19 tonnellate di carico.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Shattered Light 3|A group of people huddled around a hologram catches your attention, drawing your eyes to Ruach who gestures for you to join them. She introduces you to each person, before thanking you. "I would just like to start by offering our thanks for your assistance, Captain <first>. You have sharp eyes to pick this up as early as you did." She gestures to the hologram of the ship floating in front of you. "Other scouts reported it shortly thereafter, but you spotted it first.|481|0
units.english: A group of people huddled around a hologram catches your attention, drawing your eyes to Ruach who gestures for you to join them. She introduces you to each person, before thanking you. "I would just like to start by offering our thanks for your assistance, Captain <first>. You have sharp eyes to pick this up as early as you did." She gestures to the hologram of the ship floating in front of you. "Other scouts reported it shortly thereafter, but you spotted it first.
units.italian: Un gruppo di persone strette intorno a un ologramma attira la tua attenzione, e i tuoi occhi vanno a Ruach, che ti fa cenno di unirti a loro. Ti presenta ognuno di loro, prima di ringraziarti. "Vorrei cominciare solo con il nostro ringraziamento per il tuo aiuto, capitano <first>. Hai occhi acuti per averlo notato così presto." Gesticola verso l'ologramma della nave sospeso davanti a voi. "Altri esploratori l'hanno segnalata poco dopo, ma l'hai vista tu per primo.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Shattered Light 3|	"We have confirmed that this matches all available records of the Shattered Light, although it appears to have suffered considerable damage. One of the oldest mysteries here is what has happened to it, and what we should do about it."|482|0
units.english: "We have confirmed that this matches all available records of the Shattered Light, although it appears to have suffered considerable damage. One of the oldest mysteries here is what has happened to it, and what we should do about it."
units.italian: "Abbiamo confermato che corrisponde a tutti i registri disponibili della Shattered Light, anche se sembra aver subito danni considerevoli. Uno dei misteri più antichi qui è cosa le sia successo, e cosa dovremmo fare al riguardo."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Shattered Light 3|	Another Remnant steps forward and the hologram changes to show a scene from a cave with a large object. Other Remnant appear to aim some equipment at it, and after a moment or two, the object expands to several times its original size. "These are recordings from our explorations of the ruins, demonstrating the decompression of a Maudrakoi artifact. While not identical, these artifacts generate similar readings to those recorded during your scan of the Shattered Light.|483|0
units.english: Another Remnant steps forward and the hologram changes to show a scene from a cave with a large object. Other Remnant appear to aim some equipment at it, and after a moment or two, the object expands to several times its original size. "These are recordings from our explorations of the ruins, demonstrating the decompression of a Maudrakoi artifact. While not identical, these artifacts generate similar readings to those recorded during your scan of the Shattered Light.
units.italian: Un altro Remnant si fa avanti e l'ologramma cambia per mostrare una scena da una caverna con un grande oggetto. Altri Remnant sembrano puntare delle apparecchiature verso di esso, e dopo un momento o due l'oggetto si espande a diverse volte la sua dimensione originale. "Queste sono registrazioni delle nostre esplorazioni delle rovine, che mostrano la decompressione di un manufatto Maudrakoi. Pur non essendo identici, questi manufatti generano letture simili a quelle registrate durante la tua scansione della Shattered Light.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Shattered Light 3|	"As such, our proposition is to use the same equipment we used for decompression to stabilize the Shattered Light's weft field, and, if possible, bring it fully into synchronicity once again." She nods firmly, clapping her hands together to make the hologram vanish.|484|0
units.english: "As such, our proposition is to use the same equipment we used for decompression to stabilize the Shattered Light's weft field, and, if possible, bring it fully into synchronicity once again." She nods firmly, clapping her hands together to make the hologram vanish.
units.italian: "Perciò la nostra proposta è usare le stesse apparecchiature che abbiamo usato per la decompressione per stabilizzare il campo di trama della Shattered Light e, se possibile, riportarla del tutto in sincronia." Annuisce con fermezza, battendo le mani perché l'ologramma svanisca.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Shattered Light 3|	Ruach takes the lead again. "So, Captain, we will need you to bring us in close to the Shattered Light so we can give this a try. Our sentries have reported seeing it in the systems near Coluber, so it may take some searching."|485|0
units.english: Ruach takes the lead again. "So, Captain, we will need you to bring us in close to the Shattered Light so we can give this a try. Our sentries have reported seeing it in the systems near Coluber, so it may take some searching."
units.italian: Ruach riprende la guida. "Allora, capitano, avremo bisogno che ci porti vicino alla Shattered Light per provarci. Le nostre sentinelle hanno riferito di averla vista nei sistemi vicino a Coluber, quindi potrebbe servire un po' di ricerca."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Shattered Light 3|	"Looks good. Start loading the <ship>!"|487|0
units.english: "Looks good. Start loading the <ship>!"
units.italian: "Mi sembra bene. Cominciate a caricare la <ship>!"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Shattered Light 3|	"Wait, 'Maudrakoi'?"|489|0
units.english: "Wait, 'Maudrakoi'?"
units.italian: "Aspetta, 'Maudrakoi'?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Shattered Light 3|	The Remnant who showed the video looks startled, and then embarrassed. "My apologies, I did not realize you had not been familiarized with them." She looks around the room, then gestures. The hologram returns, now showing a large room with many shelves around the edge and several large objects within it, including some that look like Point Defense Turrets.|490|0
units.english: The Remnant who showed the video looks startled, and then embarrassed. "My apologies, I did not realize you had not been familiarized with them." She looks around the room, then gestures. The hologram returns, now showing a large room with many shelves around the edge and several large objects within it, including some that look like Point Defense Turrets.
units.italian: Il Remnant che ha mostrato il video sembra sorpreso, e poi imbarazzato. "Mi scuso, non mi ero reso conto che non ti fossero stati presentati." Si guarda intorno nella stanza, poi gesticola. L'ologramma ritorna, ora mostrando una grande stanza con molti scaffali lungo il perimetro e diversi grandi oggetti all'interno, tra cui qualcosa che assomiglia a torrette di difesa puntuale.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Shattered Light 3|	"We do not have time for an in-depth presentation, but the short version is this: the Maudrakoi are the primary civilization that lived on these worlds before we arrived. They are not the only civilization to have lived here, but they are the one we find most often in the archaeological record. Fortunately for our research, it seems that they lived extensively underground in complexes such as this one."|491|0
units.english: "We do not have time for an in-depth presentation, but the short version is this: the Maudrakoi are the primary civilization that lived on these worlds before we arrived. They are not the only civilization to have lived here, but they are the one we find most often in the archaeological record. Fortunately for our research, it seems that they lived extensively underground in complexes such as this one."
units.italian: "Non abbiamo tempo per una presentazione approfondita, ma la versione breve è questa: i Maudrakoi sono la civiltà principale che visse su questi mondi prima del nostro arrivo. Non sono l'unica civiltà ad aver vissuto qui, ma sono quella che troviamo più spesso nei reperti archeologici. Per fortuna della nostra ricerca, sembra che vivessero ampiamente nel sottosuolo, in complessi come questo."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Shattered Light 3|	Her gestures take on an appreciative tone. "The Maudrakoi made extensive use of the materials that make our ships and architecture so distinctive, and this has allowed their cities and technologies to survive the eons since they went extinct. One technology of note is they had an interesting ability to manipulate space. They used this to make large, highly complex objects, and then, for lack of a better term, partially embed them in pocket dimensions so as to not be entirely present. They used this frequently to allow equipment and materials to be much smaller than normal." She shrugs, and gestures with a frustrated tone. "We cannot replicate it, but we have figured out how to disrupt the compression, and thus recover the artifact."|492|0
units.english: Her gestures take on an appreciative tone. "The Maudrakoi made extensive use of the materials that make our ships and architecture so distinctive, and this has allowed their cities and technologies to survive the eons since they went extinct. One technology of note is they had an interesting ability to manipulate space. They used this to make large, highly complex objects, and then, for lack of a better term, partially embed them in pocket dimensions so as to not be entirely present. They used this frequently to allow equipment and materials to be much smaller than normal." She shrugs, and gestures with a frustrated tone. "We cannot replicate it, but we have figured out how to disrupt the compression, and thus recover the artifact."
units.italian: I suoi gesti prendono un tono di apprezzamento. "I Maudrakoi facevano ampio uso dei materiali che rendono le nostre navi e la nostra architettura così caratteristiche, e questo ha permesso alle loro città e tecnologie di sopravvivere agli eoni da quando si sono estinti. Una tecnologia degna di nota è che avevano un'interessante capacità di manipolare lo spazio. La usavano per creare oggetti grandi e molto complessi e poi, in mancanza di un termine migliore, li incorporavano parzialmente in dimensioni tasca, così da non essere del tutto presenti. La usavano spesso per rendere attrezzature e materiali molto più piccoli del normale." Alza le spalle e gesticola con tono frustrato. "Non possiamo replicarla, ma abbiamo capito come interrompere la compressione e quindi recuperare il manufatto."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Shattered Light 3|	The hologram shifts back to showing the Shattered Light. "This ship does not show the same signatures as the Maudrakoi artifacts, but we think it is sufficiently similar that our equipment should work on it too. Hopefully. In any case, though, time is passing, so we should start loading." With that, the Remnant gather their equipment and head out.|493|0
units.english: The hologram shifts back to showing the Shattered Light. "This ship does not show the same signatures as the Maudrakoi artifacts, but we think it is sufficiently similar that our equipment should work on it too. Hopefully. In any case, though, time is passing, so we should start loading." With that, the Remnant gather their equipment and head out.
units.italian: L'ologramma torna a mostrare la Shattered Light. "Questa nave non mostra le stesse firme dei manufatti Maudrakoi, ma pensiamo che sia abbastanza simile perché la nostra attrezzatura funzioni anche su di lei. Speriamo. In ogni caso, però, il tempo passa, quindi dovremmo cominciare a caricare." Detto questo, i Remnant radunano la loro attrezzatura e si avviano.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Shattered Light 3|dialog|496|0
units.english: Ruach briefly checks the scanning arrays before reporting that, unsurprisingly, the ship seems to not be present. She suggests searching nearby systems to locate it.
units.italian: Ruach controlla brevemente gli apparati di scansione prima di riferire che, come prevedibile, la nave sembra non essere presente. Suggerisce di cercare nei sistemi vicini per localizzarla.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Shattered Light 3|As the scan results arrive the data is relayed down to the team in the cargo hold. Your video feed shows a large hologram of the system floating in midair above one of the pallets. Nearby, terminals flash rolling readouts and analyses. As the data on the spectral ship solidifies, cones of projected courses appear on the display. Line by line the cone tightens in as additional data flows from your telemetry, closing in on a path intersecting with the nearby world.|505|0
units.english: As the scan results arrive the data is relayed down to the team in the cargo hold. Your video feed shows a large hologram of the system floating in midair above one of the pallets. Nearby, terminals flash rolling readouts and analyses. As the data on the spectral ship solidifies, cones of projected courses appear on the display. Line by line the cone tightens in as additional data flows from your telemetry, closing in on a path intersecting with the nearby world.
units.italian: Quando arrivano i risultati della scansione, i dati vengono trasmessi alla squadra nella stiva. Il tuo feed video mostra un grande ologramma del sistema sospeso a mezz'aria sopra uno dei pallet. Vicino, i terminali lampeggiano con letture e analisi in scorrimento. Mentre i dati sulla nave spettrale si consolidano, sul display appaiono coni di rotte proiettate. Riga dopo riga il cono si stringe mentre altri dati arrivano dalla tua telemetria, convergendo su un percorso che interseca il mondo vicino.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Shattered Light 3|	While the system continues to refine the orbital paths, the team seemed disinclined to wait: Ruach activates her commlink, broadcasting quickly to you. "It is on a crash course for Far Monad!" she exclaims. "Quick, land there!" Behind her, you can see her team scrambling to move equipment around near your cargo door and seal their spacesuits.|506|0
units.english: While the system continues to refine the orbital paths, the team seemed disinclined to wait: Ruach activates her commlink, broadcasting quickly to you. "It is on a crash course for Far Monad!" she exclaims. "Quick, land there!" Behind her, you can see her team scrambling to move equipment around near your cargo door and seal their spacesuits.
units.italian: Mentre il sistema continua a raffinare le orbite, la squadra sembra non avere voglia di aspettare: Ruach attiva il commlink e trasmette in fretta verso di te. "È su una rotta di collisione per Far Monad!" esclama. "Svelto, atterra lì!" Dietro di lei vedi la sua squadra affannarsi a spostare attrezzatura vicino alla porta del carico e a sigillare le tute.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Shattered Light 4|name|517|0
units.english: Shattered Light
units.italian: Shattered Light

units.id: mission:Remnant: Shattered Light 4|description|518|0
units.english: Escort the wreck back to Viminal.
units.italian: Scorta il relitto fino a Viminal.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Shattered Light 4|With the Shattered Light careening towards the surface of Far Monad, you push the <ship> into a dive. As you focus on finding a safe place to land within close proximity of the approaching ship, you notice out the corner of your eye that the Remnant team have all suited up and are pushing their equipment to the cargo hatch. A message appears on your console.|525|0
units.english: With the Shattered Light careening towards the surface of Far Monad, you push the <ship> into a dive. As you focus on finding a safe place to land within close proximity of the approaching ship, you notice out the corner of your eye that the Remnant team have all suited up and are pushing their equipment to the cargo hatch. A message appears on your console.
units.italian: Con la Shattered Light che precipita verso la superficie di Far Monad, spingi la <ship> in picchiata. Mentre ti concentri nel trovare un punto sicuro dove atterrare vicino alla nave in avvicinamento, noti con la coda dell'occhio che la squadra dei Remnant si è tutta equipaggiata e sta spingendo l'attrezzatura verso il portello del carico. Sul pannello compare un messaggio.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Shattered Light 4|	"Ready for drop, Captain. Just get us alongside the Shattered Light without too much forward velocity. We can handle the rest."|526|0
units.english: "Ready for drop, Captain. Just get us alongside the Shattered Light without too much forward velocity. We can handle the rest."
units.italian: "Pronti al lancio, capitano. Portaci solo di fianco alla Shattered Light senza troppa velocità di avanzamento. Al resto pensiamo noi."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Shattered Light 4|	Moments later you spot a gaping hole on the ship. Focusing on it, you fly the <ship> down and hold position just above it. A glance at your cargo hold display shows the Remnant vanishing out the back lock. Your exterior cameras show the equipment falling into it on repulsor pallets while the Remnant drop alongside it. A final message appears on your console.|531|0
units.english: Moments later you spot a gaping hole on the ship. Focusing on it, you fly the <ship> down and hold position just above it. A glance at your cargo hold display shows the Remnant vanishing out the back lock. Your exterior cameras show the equipment falling into it on repulsor pallets while the Remnant drop alongside it. A final message appears on your console.
units.italian: Pochi istanti dopo avvisti un buco enorme nello scafo della nave. Concentrandoti su di esso, porti la <ship> in basso e mantieni la posizione appena sopra. Un'occhiata al display della stiva mostra i Remnant che svaniscono dal portello posteriore. Le telecamere esterne mostrano l'attrezzatura che cade dentro su pallet repulsori mentre i Remnant si lanciano accanto. Sul pannello compare un ultimo messaggio.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Shattered Light 4|label|533|0
units.english: living ship
units.italian: living ship

Nodding your assent, your ship swoops to a hold position just above it. A glance at your cargo hold display shows the Remnant vanishing out the back lock. Your exterior cameras show the equipment falling into the hole on repulsor pallets while the Remnant drop alongside it. A final message appears on your console.|534|0
units.english: Moments later the <ship> pings a point on the Shattered Light indicating a gaping hole on the ship. Nodding your assent, your ship swoops to a hold position just above it. A glance at your cargo hold display shows the Remnant vanishing out the back lock. Your exterior cameras show the equipment falling into the hole on repulsor pallets while the Remnant drop alongside it. A final message appears on your console.
units.italian: Pochi istanti dopo la <ship> segnala un punto sulla Shattered Light, indicando un buco enorme nello scafo della nave. Annuisci, e la nave scivola in posizione di stazionamento appena sopra. Un'occhiata al display della stiva mostra i Remnant che svaniscono dal portello posteriore. Le telecamere esterne mostrano l'attrezzatura che cade nel buco su pallet repulsori mentre i Remnant si lanciano accanto. Sul pannello compare un ultimo messaggio.
