units.english: drop success
units.italian: drop success

units.id: mission:Remnant: Shattered Light 4|	"Drop success. Get clear of the arrival zone and pick us up after the dust settles."|536|0
units.english: "Drop success. Get clear of the arrival zone and pick us up after the dust settles."
units.italian: "Lancio riuscito. Allontanati dalla zona di arrivo e vieni a prenderci quando la polvere si sarà posata."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Shattered Light 4|	With their confirmation, you quickly pull away from the approaching wreck and retreat to a safe distance.|541|0
units.english: With their confirmation, you quickly pull away from the approaching wreck and retreat to a safe distance.
units.italian: Con la loro conferma, ti allontani rapidamente dal relitto in avvicinamento e ti ritiri a distanza di sicurezza.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Shattered Light 4|label|543|0
units.english: living clear
units.italian: living clear

units.id: mission:Remnant: Shattered Light 4|	The <ship> veers and accelerates away from the approaching wreck without waiting for your approval and retreats to a safe distance.|544|0
units.english: The <ship> veers and accelerates away from the approaching wreck without waiting for your approval and retreats to a safe distance.
units.italian: La <ship> devia e accelera via dal relitto in avvicinamento senza aspettare la tua approvazione, e si ritira a distanza di sicurezza.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Shattered Light 4|	Eventually, you find a good vantage point, several kilometers away, where you can watch the approaching ship. The Shattered Light falls through the sky with deceptive slowness, made all the worse by the fact that you can see clouds and sky passing through it. As it nears the surface you see a ripple in the air explode out from it, followed by a concussive shockwave as the Shattered Light suddenly becomes very solid. Its engines flare to life with a roar that rattles your bones and the ship lurches to a stop in mid-air, before crunching down into the forest.|546|0
units.english: Eventually, you find a good vantage point, several kilometers away, where you can watch the approaching ship. The Shattered Light falls through the sky with deceptive slowness, made all the worse by the fact that you can see clouds and sky passing through it. As it nears the surface you see a ripple in the air explode out from it, followed by a concussive shockwave as the Shattered Light suddenly becomes very solid. Its engines flare to life with a roar that rattles your bones and the ship lurches to a stop in mid-air, before crunching down into the forest.
units.italian: Alla fine trovi un buon punto di osservazione, a diversi chilometri di distanza, da cui guardare la nave in avvicinamento. La Shattered Light cade nel cielo con una lentezza ingannevole, resa peggiore dal fatto che vedi nuvole e cielo attraversarla. Mentre si avvicina alla superficie vedi un'increspatura nell'aria esplodere da essa, seguita da un'onda d'urto concussiva mentre la Shattered Light diventa improvvisamente molto solida. I suoi motori si accendono con un ruggito che ti scuote le ossa, e la nave si ferma di colpo a mezz'aria, prima di schiantarsi nella foresta.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Shattered Light 4|	The dust and debris settle within a few minutes, and soon you and the <ship> are skimming over the vegetation. The approach gives you ample time to appreciate just how massive the Shattered Light is; everything that one could need to lay the foundations for a new colony is packed into a single ship. You note large gashes in the hull, massive sensor arrays, and a shattered dome on top. Based on the mismatch of parts, this ship has been substantially modified from its original hull, and survived untold damage.|547|0
units.english: The dust and debris settle within a few minutes, and soon you and the <ship> are skimming over the vegetation. The approach gives you ample time to appreciate just how massive the Shattered Light is; everything that one could need to lay the foundations for a new colony is packed into a single ship. You note large gashes in the hull, massive sensor arrays, and a shattered dome on top. Based on the mismatch of parts, this ship has been substantially modified from its original hull, and survived untold damage.
units.italian: La polvere e i detriti si depositano in pochi minuti, e presto tu e la <ship> sorvolate la vegetazione. L'avvicinamento ti dà tutto il tempo per apprezzare quanto sia immensa la Shattered Light: tutto ciò che può servire a porre le fondamenta di una nuova colonia è stipato in una sola nave. Noti grandi squarci nello scafo, enormi apparati di sensori e una cupola in frantumi sulla cima. A giudicare dalla discordanza dei pezzi, questa nave è stata modificata in modo sostanziale rispetto allo scafo originale, e ha sopravvissuto a danni inimmaginabili.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Shattered Light 4|	As you slow to a hover alongside the ship, Ruach appears on your viewscreen. "Well met, Captain! Our theory worked! We managed to snap the Shattered Light back into the Primary Weft, and are now onboard. The systems are dubious, though, so we dare not shut anything down lest we cannot restart it. We would appreciate your assistance in escorting us back to Viminal."|548|0
units.english: As you slow to a hover alongside the ship, Ruach appears on your viewscreen. "Well met, Captain! Our theory worked! We managed to snap the Shattered Light back into the Primary Weft, and are now onboard. The systems are dubious, though, so we dare not shut anything down lest we cannot restart it. We would appreciate your assistance in escorting us back to Viminal."
units.italian: Mentre rallenti in stazionamento accanto alla nave, Ruach appare sul tuo schermo. "Ben incontrato, capitano! La nostra teoria ha funzionato! Siamo riusciti a riportare la Shattered Light nella Trama Primaria, e ora siamo a bordo. I sistemi sono dubbi, però, quindi non osiamo spegnere nulla per paura di non riuscire a riavviarlo. Apprezzeremmo il tuo aiuto per scortarci a Viminal."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Shattered Light 4|The Shattered Light is so massive that traffic control directs you to a large valley next to the spaceport, where you discover that a section of the chasm has been covered to create a semi-enclosed area. Judging from the equipment and stacks of cargo, this area looks like it is predominantly used by bulk freight shipments and little else. Now, however, as the Shattered Light slowly moves in, a flock of Pelicans scatter in front of it looking like nothing more than a flock of plovers in front of an approaching camel.|564|0
units.english: The Shattered Light is so massive that traffic control directs you to a large valley next to the spaceport, where you discover that a section of the chasm has been covered to create a semi-enclosed area. Judging from the equipment and stacks of cargo, this area looks like it is predominantly used by bulk freight shipments and little else. Now, however, as the Shattered Light slowly moves in, a flock of Pelicans scatter in front of it looking like nothing more than a flock of plovers in front of an approaching camel.
units.italian: La Shattered Light è così imponente che il controllo del traffico ti indirizza a una grande valle accanto allo spazioporto, dove scopri che una sezione del baratro è stata coperta per creare un'area semi-chiusa. A giudicare dalle attrezzature e dalle pile di carico, quest'area sembra usata soprattutto per spedizioni di merci sfuse e poco altro. Ora però, mentre la Shattered Light si avvicina lentamente, uno stormo di Pelican si disperde davanti a lei come nient'altro che uno stormo di pivieri davanti a un cammello in arrivo.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Shattered Light 4|	Down on the ground, you see Ruach and her team exit an airlock on the side of the Shattered Light and jump down to the ground. They gather around, giving hugs. "<first>!" exclaims Ruach. "We have recovered a lost piece of Remnant history. Thank you for helping. I do not know what this will mean for us in the long term, but there will be a lot of careful examination for the next few weeks."|565|0
units.english: Down on the ground, you see Ruach and her team exit an airlock on the side of the Shattered Light and jump down to the ground. They gather around, giving hugs. "<first>!" exclaims Ruach. "We have recovered a lost piece of Remnant history. Thank you for helping. I do not know what this will mean for us in the long term, but there will be a lot of careful examination for the next few weeks."
units.italian: A terra, vedi Ruach e la sua squadra uscire da una camera di equilibrio sul fianco della Shattered Light e saltare giù. Si radunano intorno, abbracciandosi. "<first>!" esclama Ruach. "Abbiamo recuperato un pezzo perduto della storia dei Remnant. Grazie per il tuo aiuto. Non so cosa significhi per noi a lungo termine, ma ci saranno molti esami accurati nelle prossime settimane."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Shattered Light 4|	"I have things to do, so just let me know if I can help."|567|0
units.english: "I have things to do, so just let me know if I can help."
units.italian: "Ho cose da fare, quindi fammi sapere se posso aiutare."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Shattered Light 4|	"So, what happened?"|569|0
units.english: "So, what happened?"
units.italian: "Allora, cosa è successo?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Shattered Light 4|	The team of Remnant are almost too excited for you to understand their gestures, but one calms down enough that their signing is comprehensible. "To be honest, we were expecting this to be the first of several trips doing detailed scans and trying out different sorts of synchronization fields. But when we saw that it was heading to the planet..." She trails off, and another one continues. "We already had the sensors running as we approached, so we jumped and triggered the fields as soon as we got a reasonable match."|570|0
units.english: The team of Remnant are almost too excited for you to understand their gestures, but one calms down enough that their signing is comprehensible. "To be honest, we were expecting this to be the first of several trips doing detailed scans and trying out different sorts of synchronization fields. But when we saw that it was heading to the planet..." She trails off, and another one continues. "We already had the sensors running as we approached, so we jumped and triggered the fields as soon as we got a reasonable match."
units.italian: La squadra di Remnant è quasi troppo eccitata perché tu possa capire i loro gesti, ma uno si calma abbastanza che il suo segnare diventa comprensibile. "A dire il vero ci aspettavamo che questo fosse il primo di diversi viaggi, con scansioni dettagliate e prove di diversi tipi di campi di sincronizzazione. Ma quando abbiamo visto che puntava al pianeta..." Si interrompe, e un altro continua. "Avevamo già i sensori attivi in avvicinamento, quindi ci siamo lanciati e abbiamo attivato i campi appena abbiamo ottenuto una corrispondenza ragionevole."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Shattered Light 4|	He frowns a bit. "It worked, although not perfectly. There are chunks missing, some of which seriously impair its functionality. But it is back in the Primary Weft, so now we have time to work on it and figure out what happened to it."|571|0
units.english: He frowns a bit. "It worked, although not perfectly. There are chunks missing, some of which seriously impair its functionality. But it is back in the Primary Weft, so now we have time to work on it and figure out what happened to it."
units.italian: Fa una leggera smorfia. "Ha funzionato, anche se non perfettamente. Mancano dei pezzi, alcuni dei quali compromettono seriamente la funzionalità. Ma è di nuovo nella Trama Primaria, quindi ora abbiamo il tempo di lavorarci e capire cosa le è successo."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Shattered Light 4|	"I think I get the picture. Let me know if I can help."|573|0
units.english: "I think I get the picture. Let me know if I can help."
units.italian: "Credo di aver capito il quadro. Fammi sapere se posso aiutare."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Shattered Light 4|	"What is this 'Primary Weft' you have mentioned?"|575|0
units.english: "What is this 'Primary Weft' you have mentioned?"
units.italian: "Che cos'è questa 'Trama Primaria' di cui avete parlato?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Shattered Light 4|	Another Remnant steps forward. "The Weft is what we term the mesh of dimensions, energy, and time that form a subset of the universe. A layer, of sorts." He looks thoughtful. "What you probably know as 'Hyperspace' is what we technically call the Secondary Weft. There are a few others we are fairly confident exist, and several that we have hypothesized might exist but we have no means of confirming. Practically, each of these overlaps with the Primary Weft to some extent." His gestures take on an amused tone. "Of course, what we call the Primary Weft is only primary to those of us who live here. For all we know, there may be people living elsewhere that consider their own weft to be the primary one. Nothing says ours is special or the best or anything of the sort. Actually, it has been proposed that we call the Primary Weft the Warp. It is an old weaving term that serves as a reasonable analogy to how the warp and weft interact, and might better reflect its status instead of being labeled 'Primary.'|576|0
units.english: Another Remnant steps forward. "The Weft is what we term the mesh of dimensions, energy, and time that form a subset of the universe. A layer, of sorts." He looks thoughtful. "What you probably know as 'Hyperspace' is what we technically call the Secondary Weft. There are a few others we are fairly confident exist, and several that we have hypothesized might exist but we have no means of confirming. Practically, each of these overlaps with the Primary Weft to some extent." His gestures take on an amused tone. "Of course, what we call the Primary Weft is only primary to those of us who live here. For all we know, there may be people living elsewhere that consider their own weft to be the primary one. Nothing says ours is special or the best or anything of the sort. Actually, it has been proposed that we call the Primary Weft the Warp. It is an old weaving term that serves as a reasonable analogy to how the warp and weft interact, and might better reflect its status instead of being labeled 'Primary.'
units.italian: Un altro Remnant si fa avanti. "La Trama è quello che chiamiamo l'intreccio di dimensioni, energia e tempo che forma un sottoinsieme dell'universo. Una specie di strato." Resta pensieroso. "Quello che probabilmente conosci come 'iperspazio' è ciò che tecnicamente chiamiamo Trama Secondaria. Ce ne sono altri che siamo abbastanza certi esistano, e diversi che abbiamo ipotizzato ma non abbiamo modo di confermare. In pratica, ognuno di questi si sovrappone in qualche misura alla Trama Primaria." I suoi gesti prendono un tono divertito. "Certo, quella che chiamiamo Trama Primaria è primaria solo per noi che viviamo qui. Per quanto ne sappiamo, potrebbero esserci popoli altrove che considerano primaria la propria trama. Nulla dice che la nostra sia speciale, o la migliore, o cose del genere. In realtà è stato proposto di chiamare la Trama Primaria Ordito. È un vecchio termine tessile che funziona come analogia ragionevole di come interagiscono ordito e trama, e potrebbe rifletterne meglio lo status invece di essere etichettata 'Primaria'.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Shattered Light 4|label|577|0
units.english: shattered help
units.italian: shattered help

units.id: mission:Remnant: Shattered Light 4|	"In terms of help, could you go to Caelian? We have sent word ahead, and our engineers are retrieving some of our remaining equipment from the time of the Exodus. We are hoping that it might be of use to help us repair the Shattered Light, or at least understand what happened to it.|578|0
units.english: "In terms of help, could you go to Caelian? We have sent word ahead, and our engineers are retrieving some of our remaining equipment from the time of the Exodus. We are hoping that it might be of use to help us repair the Shattered Light, or at least understand what happened to it.
units.italian: "Quanto all'aiuto, potresti andare su Caelian? Abbiamo mandato parola, e i nostri ingegneri stanno recuperando parte delle nostre apparecchiature rimaste dall'epoca dell'Esodo. Speriamo che possano essere utili per riparare la Shattered Light, o almeno per capire cosa le è successo.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Shattered Light 4|	"Before you leave, though, there was some stuff that survived intact we would like to share with you." Behind her five androids emerge from one of the cargo holds, each one carrying a large trunk of equipment.|579|0
units.english: "Before you leave, though, there was some stuff that survived intact we would like to share with you." Behind her five androids emerge from one of the cargo holds, each one carrying a large trunk of equipment.
units.italian: "Prima che tu parta, però, ci sono alcune cose sopravvissute intatte che vorremmo condividere con te." Dietro di lei, da una delle stive escono cinque androidi, ognuno con un grande baule di attrezzatura.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Shattered Light 4|	"These are known as NDR-114 Androids, and were cutting edge innovations back when the Exodus occurred. Don't expect too much of them. They are not self-aware, sentient, or even particularly advanced artificial intelligences. They are, however, excellent extensions of a ship's self-maintenance systems. As it turns out, a large number of these androids were instrumental in keeping the Shattered Light flying all these years. We have plenty to study, so we thought you might appreciate having a few." She makes a dismissive gesture. "If they end up not being helpful for you, our outfitters will be able to re-assign them to another ship.|581|0
units.english: "These are known as NDR-114 Androids, and were cutting edge innovations back when the Exodus occurred. Don't expect too much of them. They are not self-aware, sentient, or even particularly advanced artificial intelligences. They are, however, excellent extensions of a ship's self-maintenance systems. As it turns out, a large number of these androids were instrumental in keeping the Shattered Light flying all these years. We have plenty to study, so we thought you might appreciate having a few." She makes a dismissive gesture. "If they end up not being helpful for you, our outfitters will be able to re-assign them to another ship.
units.italian: "Questi sono noti come Androidi NDR-114, ed erano innovazioni all'avanguardia quando avvenne l'Esodo. Non aspettarti troppo da loro. Non sono autocoscienti, senzienti, né intelligenze artificiali particolarmente avanzate. Sono però ottime estensioni dei sistemi di automanutenzione di una nave. A quanto pare, un gran numero di questi androidi è stato determinante per tenere in volo la Shattered Light tutti questi anni. Abbiamo molto da studiare, quindi abbiamo pensato che ti facesse piacere averne qualcuno." Fa un gesto di noncuranza. "Se alla fine non ti saranno utili, i nostri fornitori potranno riassegnarli a un'altra nave.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Shattered Light 4|	"Embers light your path, Captain <first>." With that, the crowd disperses.|582|0
units.english: "Embers light your path, Captain <first>." With that, the crowd disperses.
units.italian: "Che le Braci illuminino il tuo cammino, capitano <first>." Detto questo, la folla si disperde.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Shattered Light 5|name|588|0
units.english: Brilliant Energy
units.italian: Energia brillante

units.id: mission:Remnant: Shattered Light 5|description|589|0
units.english: Retrieve a team with their equipment from <destination> to help research the Shattered Light.
units.italian: Recupera una squadra con la sua attrezzatura da <destination> per aiutare a studiare la Shattered Light.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Shattered Light 6|name|599|0
units.english: Shattered Light
units.italian: Shattered Light

units.id: mission:Remnant: Shattered Light 6|description|600|0
units.english: Ferry the team and their gear back to <destination>.
units.italian: Riporta la squadra e la sua attrezzatura su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Shattered Light 6|blocked|601|0
units.english: From your count at the information desk, you estimate that you need space for 11 people as well as 18 tons of cargo.
units.italian: Dal tuo conteggio al banco informazioni, calcoli che ti serve spazio per 11 persone e 18 tonnellate di carico.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Shattered Light 6|On <origin>, the spaceport is awash in conversation, and you spot snippets here and there of people talking about the recovery of the Shattered Light. Many are speculating as to what happened to it in the first place, while others are discussing the technical merits of what the research team did to recover it. Details travel quickly, it seems.|610|0
units.english: On <origin>, the spaceport is awash in conversation, and you spot snippets here and there of people talking about the recovery of the Shattered Light. Many are speculating as to what happened to it in the first place, while others are discussing the technical merits of what the research team did to recover it. Details travel quickly, it seems.
units.italian: Su <origin>, lo spazioporto è un brusio di conversazioni, e cogli qua e là frammenti di gente che parla del recupero della Shattered Light. Molti fanno congetture su cosa le sia successo in origine, mentre altri discutono dei meriti tecnici di ciò che la squadra di ricerca ha fatto per recuperarla. A quanto pare, i dettagli viaggiano in fretta.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Shattered Light 6|	The team you are sent to pick up are waiting next to the information desk. They have a collection of pallets nearby, and a small crowd is gathered around them in animated conversation. They spot you and the crowd start waving their goodbyes as the group pick up their bags and head towards you.|611|0
units.english: The team you are sent to pick up are waiting next to the information desk. They have a collection of pallets nearby, and a small crowd is gathered around them in animated conversation. They spot you and the crowd start waving their goodbyes as the group pick up their bags and head towards you.
units.italian: La squadra che sei andato a prendere aspetta accanto al banco informazioni. Hanno una collezione di pallet lì vicino, e un piccolo capannello si è radunato intorno a loro in animata conversazione. Ti notano e la folla comincia a salutarli con la mano mentre il gruppo prende le proprie borse e si dirige verso di te.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Shattered Light 6|	"Ah, <first>! Thank you for transporting us. We are excited to see the Shattered Light and start studying this mystery you have found." They briskly head to your ship.|612|0
units.english: "Ah, <first>! Thank you for transporting us. We are excited to see the Shattered Light and start studying this mystery you have found." They briskly head to your ship.
units.italian: "Ah, <first>! Grazie per il trasporto. Non vediamo l'ora di vedere la Shattered Light e cominciare a studiare questo mistero che hai trovato." Si dirigono a passo svelto verso la tua nave.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Shattered Light 6|The Remnant spend the trip busily discussing what is known so far and exchanging theories, eagerly asking you questions about what you saw and reviewing your sensor records. By the time you reach Viminal, they have a whole collection of theories and have a preliminary plan of what studies they hope to do. When pressed, however, they all acknowledge that their top priority will be documenting the ship. Every scratch, every oddly charged component, every minor modification. "After all," they say, "knowing how it is now is the first step to determining how it arrived here."|618|0
units.english: The Remnant spend the trip busily discussing what is known so far and exchanging theories, eagerly asking you questions about what you saw and reviewing your sensor records. By the time you reach Viminal, they have a whole collection of theories and have a preliminary plan of what studies they hope to do. When pressed, however, they all acknowledge that their top priority will be documenting the ship. Every scratch, every oddly charged component, every minor modification. "After all," they say, "knowing how it is now is the first step to determining how it arrived here."
units.italian: I Remnant passano il viaggio discutendo animatamente di ciò che si sa finora e scambiandosi teorie, chiedendoti con impazienza cosa hai visto e rivedendo i registri dei tuoi sensori. Quando arrivi a Viminal hanno già un'intera collezione di teorie e un piano preliminare degli studi che sperano di fare. Se incalzati, però, ammettono tutti che la loro priorità assoluta sarà documentare la nave. Ogni graffio, ogni componente caricato in modo strano, ogni minima modifica. "Dopotutto," dicono, "sapere com'è adesso è il primo passo per determinare come è arrivata qui."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Shattered Light 6|	The entire complement of Remnant crowd the windows when you settle into the final approach for the covered valley that houses the Shattered Light. You can see that the Remnant have been busy setting up large equipment towers around it, including several small encampments of tents. As you settle in for a landing, you see a camel team maneuver a sled with a large anti-aircraft battery into position, where it is promptly shrouded in a tent that blends into the rest of the camp.|619|0
units.english: The entire complement of Remnant crowd the windows when you settle into the final approach for the covered valley that houses the Shattered Light. You can see that the Remnant have been busy setting up large equipment towers around it, including several small encampments of tents. As you settle in for a landing, you see a camel team maneuver a sled with a large anti-aircraft battery into position, where it is promptly shrouded in a tent that blends into the rest of the camp.
units.italian: L'intero gruppo di Remnant si affolla alle finestre quando ti avvicini all'ultima fase dell'atterraggio nella valle coperta che ospita la Shattered Light. Vedi che i Remnant sono stati indaffarati a montare grandi torri di attrezzature intorno alla nave, compresi diversi piccoli accampamenti di tende. Mentre ti posizioni per atterrare, vedi una squadra di cammelli manovrare una slitta con una grande batteria antiaerea in posizione, dove viene subito avvolta in una tenda che si mimetizza con il resto dell'accampamento.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Shattered Light 6|	Traffic control directs you to a pad near a large door of the Shattered Light. Ruach and a small group of Remnant are gathered around a hologram of the ship, and seem to be co-ordinating teams exploring it. Large mounds of equipment appear to have expanded from the sides of the ship, some of which appears to be functional. As you go through your landing checks, the team thank you for the transportation and begin offloading their equipment.|620|0
units.english: Traffic control directs you to a pad near a large door of the Shattered Light. Ruach and a small group of Remnant are gathered around a hologram of the ship, and seem to be co-ordinating teams exploring it. Large mounds of equipment appear to have expanded from the sides of the ship, some of which appears to be functional. As you go through your landing checks, the team thank you for the transportation and begin offloading their equipment.
units.italian: Il controllo del traffico ti indirizza a una piazzola vicino a un grande portello della Shattered Light. Ruach e un piccolo gruppo di Remnant sono riuniti intorno a un ologramma della nave, e sembrano coordinare le squadre che la esplorano. Grandi mucchi di attrezzatura sembrano essersi espansi dai fianchi della nave, parte della quale sembra funzionante. Mentre completi i controlli di atterraggio, la squadra ti ringrazia per il trasporto e comincia a scaricare la propria attrezzatura.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Shattered Light 6|	"Welcome back, <first>!" signs Ruach from across the pad. "We have made considerable progress already." She appears set to explain what they have discovered.|621|0
units.english: "Welcome back, <first>!" signs Ruach from across the pad. "We have made considerable progress already." She appears set to explain what they have discovered.
units.italian: "Bentornato, <first>!" segna Ruach dall'altra parte della piazzola. "Abbiamo già fatto progressi considerevoli." Sembra sul punto di spiegarti cosa hanno scoperto.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Shattered Light 6|	"Great, but please spare me the details."|623|0
units.english: "Great, but please spare me the details."
units.italian: "Bene, ma risparmiami i dettagli."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Shattered Light 6|	"You figured out what happened? Great!"|625|0
units.english: "You figured out what happened? Great!"
units.italian: "Avete capito cosa è successo? Ottimo!"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Shattered Light 6|	She looks crestfallen. "Well, we know what the ship thinks happened, anyway. It is likely that what actually happened differs significantly." Her posture takes on a more positive stance. "We have had the opportunity to start querying the onboard systems and piece together a little of the Shattered Light's history. Particularly the logs.|626|0
units.english: She looks crestfallen. "Well, we know what the ship thinks happened, anyway. It is likely that what actually happened differs significantly." Her posture takes on a more positive stance. "We have had the opportunity to start querying the onboard systems and piece together a little of the Shattered Light's history. Particularly the logs.
units.italian: Sembra delusa. "Beh, sappiamo cosa pensa la nave che sia successo, almeno. È probabile che quello che è successo davvero sia molto diverso." La sua postura si fa più positiva. "Abbiamo avuto la possibilità di cominciare a interrogare i sistemi di bordo e di ricostruire un po' della storia della Shattered Light. Soprattutto i registri.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Shattered Light 6|	"As we all know, it was part of the Exodus fleet that entered the Terminus wormhole. Unlike most of the other ships, however, it never emerged from the other side. Fortunately, it had a significantly larger array of instruments than was normal for ships of its type, and it looks like at least some of the databanks survived."|627|0
units.english: "As we all know, it was part of the Exodus fleet that entered the Terminus wormhole. Unlike most of the other ships, however, it never emerged from the other side. Fortunately, it had a significantly larger array of instruments than was normal for ships of its type, and it looks like at least some of the databanks survived."
units.italian: "Come sappiamo tutti, faceva parte della flotta dell'Esodo che entrò nel cunicolo Terminus. A differenza della maggior parte delle altre navi, però, non ne è mai emersa dall'altra parte. Per fortuna aveva un apparato di strumenti molto più ampio del normale per navi del suo tipo, e sembra che almeno alcune banche dati siano sopravvissute."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Shattered Light 6|	At this point another Remnant takes up the narrative. "Based on the initial incident logs, it appears that something in the stabilization fields failed during transit. The data is not clear whether the systems failed, or if something in the wormhole fluctuations exceeded the parameters that the systems could handle. In any case, the ship appears to have been shunted laterally from the wormhole in mid-transit.|628|0
units.english: At this point another Remnant takes up the narrative. "Based on the initial incident logs, it appears that something in the stabilization fields failed during transit. The data is not clear whether the systems failed, or if something in the wormhole fluctuations exceeded the parameters that the systems could handle. In any case, the ship appears to have been shunted laterally from the wormhole in mid-transit.
units.italian: A questo punto un altro Remnant riprende il racconto. "In base ai registri iniziali dell'incidente, sembra che qualcosa nei campi di stabilizzazione abbia ceduto durante il transito. I dati non chiariscono se siano stati i sistemi a cedere, o se qualcosa nelle fluttuazioni del cunicolo abbia superato i parametri che i sistemi potevano gestire. In ogni caso, la nave sembra essere stata spostata lateralmente rispetto al cunicolo a metà transito.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Shattered Light 6|	"It is unclear what happened after that, but the ship was subject to significant forces including unidentified impacts that caused multiple system failures. The data loses some coherence at this point, but it basically seems to have been semi-permanently stuck out-of-phase with the prime weft until an energy surge destabilized it and it wobbled back into prime coherence. At that point, it started being visible again, and shortly after, you spotted it."|629|0
units.english: "It is unclear what happened after that, but the ship was subject to significant forces including unidentified impacts that caused multiple system failures. The data loses some coherence at this point, but it basically seems to have been semi-permanently stuck out-of-phase with the prime weft until an energy surge destabilized it and it wobbled back into prime coherence. At that point, it started being visible again, and shortly after, you spotted it."
units.italian: "Non è chiaro cosa sia successo dopo, ma la nave è stata sottoposta a forze notevoli, compresi impatti non identificati che hanno causato molteplici guasti ai sistemi. I dati perdono un po' di coerenza a questo punto, ma in sostanza sembra che sia rimasta bloccata semi-permanentemente fuori fase rispetto alla trama primaria finché un picco di energia non l'ha destabilizzata e l'ha fatta tornare ondeggiando in coerente con la primaria. A quel punto ha ricominciato a essere visibile, e poco dopo l'hai avvistata tu."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Shattered Light 6|	"Interesting. Well, let me know if I can help."|631|0
units.english: "Interesting. Well, let me know if I can help."
units.italian: "Interessante. Bene, fammi sapere se posso aiutare."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Shattered Light 6|	"I am curious as to what you will do now."|633|0
units.english: "I am curious as to what you will do now."
units.italian: "Sono curioso di sapere cosa farete adesso."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Shattered Light 6|	"The first step will be to unpack the Shattered Light and set up all its equipment. Taking detailed scans of each piece as we do so, of course." She gestures around at the equipment expanding out of the side of the ship. "As you can see, we have already started the process and found that much of it is operational."|634|0
units.english: "The first step will be to unpack the Shattered Light and set up all its equipment. Taking detailed scans of each piece as we do so, of course." She gestures around at the equipment expanding out of the side of the ship. "As you can see, we have already started the process and found that much of it is operational."
units.italian: "Il primo passo sarà aprire la Shattered Light e installare tutta la sua attrezzatura. Facendo scansioni dettagliate di ogni pezzo mentre procediamo, naturalmente." Gesticola intorno verso l'attrezzatura che si espande dal fianco della nave. "Come vedi, abbiamo già cominciato e abbiamo scoperto che gran parte è operativa."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Shattered Light 6|	One of the other Remnant continues. "The Shattered Light carried what amounts to an entire heavy industrial factory. Everything from smelters to welding equipment and everything in between." They smile and their gestures take on a tone of irony. "In fact, the ships we have now are in no small part due to the Shattered Light's absence. Without these capabilities, the choice about whether or not to commit to learning the techniques of those who lived here before us was much easier. If the Shattered Light had arrived on schedule we may well still be building ships out of the traditional materials prevalent at the time."|635|0
units.english: One of the other Remnant continues. "The Shattered Light carried what amounts to an entire heavy industrial factory. Everything from smelters to welding equipment and everything in between." They smile and their gestures take on a tone of irony. "In fact, the ships we have now are in no small part due to the Shattered Light's absence. Without these capabilities, the choice about whether or not to commit to learning the techniques of those who lived here before us was much easier. If the Shattered Light had arrived on schedule we may well still be building ships out of the traditional materials prevalent at the time."
units.italian: Un altro dei Remnant continua. "La Shattered Light trasportava quello che equivale a un'intera fabbrica industriale pesante. Tutto, dai forni fusori alle attrezzature per la saldatura e tutto quello che c'è in mezzo." Sorridono e i loro gesti prendono un tono ironico. "In effetti, le navi che abbiamo oggi dipendono in non piccola parte dall'assenza della Shattered Light. Senza queste capacità, la scelta se impegnarci o meno a imparare le tecniche di chi viveva qui prima di noi era molto più facile. Se la Shattered Light fosse arrivata puntuale, probabilmente staremmo ancora costruendo navi con i materiali tradizionali prevalenti allora."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Shattered Light 6|label|637|0
units.english: shattered help
units.italian: shattered help

units.id: mission:Remnant: Shattered Light 6|	"Thank you, Captain. Of course we do not want to keep you waiting, so rest assured that we will contact you if your assistance is needed in the future."|638|0
units.english: "Thank you, Captain. Of course we do not want to keep you waiting, so rest assured that we will contact you if your assistance is needed in the future."
units.italian: "Grazie, capitano. Naturalmente non vogliamo farti aspettare, quindi stai pur certo che ti contatteremo se in futuro servirà il tuo aiuto."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Shattered Light 6|label|639|0
units.english: shattered request
units.italian: shattered request

units.id: mission:Remnant: Shattered Light 6|	Ruach's gestures take on a tone of curiosity. "One thing that you could help us with, if you wish, is resources. That being said, if ever you would like a replica of the Shattered Light, we could use this equipment to build one."|640|0
units.english: Ruach's gestures take on a tone of curiosity. "One thing that you could help us with, if you wish, is resources. Right now we do not have any real need to put all this machinery to work, and as such we do not have the resources to spare to get it fully operational. That being said, if ever you would like a replica of the Shattered Light, we could use this equipment to build one."
units.italian: I gesti di Ruach prendono un tono di curiosità. "Una cosa in cui potresti aiutarci, se vuoi, sono le risorse. Al momento non abbiamo un vero bisogno di mettere in funzione tutti questi macchinari, e quindi non abbiamo risorse da dedicare per renderli pienamente operativi. Detto questo, se mai volessi una replica della Shattered Light, potremmo usare questa attrezzatura per costruirne una."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Shattered Light 6|	Her gestures take on an apologetic tone. "It will not be a perfect replica as we will have to use our own systems for most of the internals, and the resource allotment cost will be significantly higher than it would have been back at the Tycho Crater shipyard on Luna... but if you have the resources and interest, the opportunity is there. The shipyard will have more information for you in a day or two." Her gestures trail off with a sign that indicates vast possibilities.|641|0
units.english: Her gestures take on an apologetic tone. "It will not be a perfect replica as we will have to use our own systems for most of the internals, and the resource allotment cost will be significantly higher than it would have been back at the Tycho Crater shipyard on Luna... but if you have the resources and interest, the opportunity is there. The shipyard will have more information for you in a day or two." Her gestures trail off with a sign that indicates vast possibilities.
units.italian: I suoi gesti prendono un tono di scusa. "Non sarà una replica perfetta, perché dovremo usare i nostri sistemi per gran parte degli interni, e il costo in assegnazione di risorse sarà molto più alto di quanto sarebbe stato al cantiere del cratere Tycho, sulla Luna... ma se hai le risorse e l'interesse, l'opportunità c'è. Il cantiere avrà informazioni più precise per te entro un giorno o due." I suoi gesti si perdono in un segno che indica vaste possibilità.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Shattered Light 6|	"Someday, Captain <first>, much may come from this. But for now, it will be months before we have analyzed everything. Thank you for helping recover a piece of our history, Captain."|642|0
units.english: "Someday, Captain <first>, much may come from this. But for now, it will be months before we have analyzed everything. Thank you for helping recover a piece of our history, Captain."
units.italian: "Un giorno, capitano <first>, molto potrà venire da questo. Ma per ora ci vorranno mesi prima di aver analizzato tutto. Grazie per aver aiutato a recuperare un pezzo della nostra storia, capitano."

units.italian: Cerca la nave Korath sconosciuta

units.id: mission:Remnant: Scent of Rain 1|description|649|0
units.english: Chilia has asked you to find and conduct an outfit scan of the Korath ship that can carry three 'olofezes, then report back to <destination>. The Remnant believe it will be found in one of the southern Korath systems.
units.italian: Chilia ti ha chiesto di trovare e scansionare l'equipaggiamento della nave Korath che può trasportare tre 'olofez, poi di riferire su <destination>. I Remnant credono che si trovi in uno dei sistemi Korath meridionali.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Scent of Rain 1|You step out of your airlock to see Prefect Chilia striding towards you. "Captain <first>! We would like to track down where those came from."
units.italian: Esci dalla camera di equilibrio e vedi il Prefetto Chilia che ti viene incontro a grandi passi. "Capitano <first>! Ho letto un rapporto che menziona il fatto che ti sei occupato di un terzetto di 'olofez nella regione di Postverta. Ti interesserebbe fare un po' di ricognizione per noi? Vorremmo rintracciare da dove venivano."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Scent of Rain 1|	"Yes, I could do that."|670|0

units.italian: "Sì, potrei farlo."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Scent of Rain 1|	"I would rather not."|671|0
units.english: "I would rather not."
units.italian: "Preferirei di no."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Scent of Rain 1|	He signs appreciatively. "We admire your willingness to help." He pulls up a hologram of the Ember Waste, and it shifts to display the systems towards the core. "We are concerned that the Korath may have a new ship that can carry three fighters. Based on the Korath's typical movement patterns, we suspect that - if such a ship exists - it should be somewhere in the nearer Korath systems. We will upload an algorithm to your targeting system to look for ship profiles that have no matches in our database. Please do an outfit scan of whatever ship you find, and report back to me on <destination>."|673|0
units.english: He signs appreciatively. "We admire your willingness to help." He pulls up a hologram of the Ember Waste, and it shifts to display the systems towards the core. "We are concerned that the Korath may have a new ship that can carry three fighters. Based on the Korath's typical movement patterns, we suspect that - if such a ship exists - it should be somewhere in the nearer Korath systems. We will upload an algorithm to your targeting system to look for ship profiles that have no matches in our database. Please do an outfit scan of whatever ship you find, and report back to me on <destination>."
units.italian: Segna con apprezzamento. "Ammiriamo la tua disponibilità ad aiutarci." Apre un ologramma della Distesa di Braci, che cambia per mostrare i sistemi verso il nucleo. "Ci preoccupa che i Korath possano avere una nuova nave capace di trasportare tre caccia. In base ai tipici schemi di movimento dei Korath, sospettiamo che - se una nave del genere esiste - debba trovarsi in uno dei sistemi Korath più vicini. Caricheremo un algoritmo nel tuo sistema di puntamento per cercare profili di nave che non hanno corrispondenze nel nostro database. Per favore, fai una scansione dell'equipaggiamento di qualunque nave trovi, e riferisci a me su <destination>."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Scent of Rain 1|label|675|0
units.english: rather not
units.italian: rather not

units.id: mission:Remnant: Scent of Rain 1|	He nods respectfully. "Well, thank you for all that you have done for us. I will see who else is available." With that, he heads off into the starport.|676|0
units.english: He nods respectfully. "Well, thank you for all that you have done for us. I will see who else is available." With that, he heads off into the starport.
units.italian: Annuisce con rispetto. "Beh, grazie per tutto quello che hai fatto per noi. Vedrò chi altro è disponibile." Detto questo, si dirige verso lo spazioporto.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Scent of Rain 1|dialog|683|0
units.english: In poor lighting, this ship might have passed for a Palavret, but scanning reveals major structural differences. These suggest this is at least a new generation of the model, or perhaps an entirely different design. Time to report this to Chilia.
units.italian: Con una luce scarsa questa nave sarebbe potuta passare per un Palavret, ma la scansione rivela differenze strutturali importanti. Suggeriscono che si tratti almeno di una nuova generazione del modello, o forse di un progetto del tutto diverso. È ora di riferire a Chilia.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Scent of Rain 1|The algorithm quickly parses the ship signatures present here, and notifies you that one in particular does not match its database: the one identified as the "Ra'puk At 333." This must be the ship that Chilia would like a scan of.|697|0
units.english: The algorithm quickly parses the ship signatures present here, and notifies you that one in particular does not match its database: the one identified as the "Ra'puk At 333." This must be the ship that Chilia would like a scan of.
units.italian: L'algoritmo analizza in fretta le firme delle navi presenti e ti avvisa che una in particolare non corrisponde al suo database: quella identificata come "Ra'puk At 333". Deve essere la nave di cui Chilia vorrebbe una scansione.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Scent of Rain 1|Chilia is waiting for you when you land. Judging by the hologram floating before him, he appears to already be reviewing the data from your scan. As you approach, he pushes it to the side to focus on you. "This is interesting data," he comments. "What are your thoughts, having seen it first hand?"|701|0
units.english: Chilia is waiting for you when you land. Judging by the hologram floating before him, he appears to already be reviewing the data from your scan. As you approach, he pushes it to the side to focus on you. "This is interesting data," he comments. "What are your thoughts, having seen it first hand?"
units.italian: Chilia ti aspetta quando atterri. A giudicare dall'ologramma che gli fluttua davanti, sembra stia già rivedendo i dati della tua scansione. Mentre ti avvicini, lo spinge da parte per concentrarsi su di te. "Sono dati interessanti," commenta. "Che ne pensi, avendoli visti in prima persona?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Scent of Rain 1|	"You were right in suspecting that this new ship carries an additional fighter. One more fighter might not change much in combat, but if the Korath are building new warships, they may also be building stronger fighters."|703|0
units.english: "You were right in suspecting that this new ship carries an additional fighter. One more fighter might not change much in combat, but if the Korath are building new warships, they may also be building stronger fighters."
units.italian: "Avevi ragione a sospettare che questa nuova nave trasporti un caccia in più. Un caccia in più potrebbe non cambiare molto in combattimento, ma se i Korath stanno costruendo nuove navi da guerra, potrebbero stare costruendo anche caccia più forti."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Scent of Rain 1|	"An extra fighter bay isn't the only thing this new ship has. It also comes with an extra gun, bigger engines, superior shields and hull, and likely other unseen improvements. Overall it's much more formidable than its predecessor."|704|0
units.english: "An extra fighter bay isn't the only thing this new ship has. It also comes with an extra gun, bigger engines, superior shields and hull, and likely other unseen improvements. Overall it's much more formidable than its predecessor."
units.italian: "Un alloggiamento per caccia in più non è l'unica cosa che ha questa nuova nave. Ha anche un cannone in più, motori più grandi, scudi e scafo superiori, e probabilmente altri miglioramenti non visibili. Nel complesso è molto più formidabile del suo predecessore."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Scent of Rain 1|	He listens attentively to your account of visiting Kor Zena'i, nodding thoughtfully at various insights.|705|0
units.english: He listens attentively to your account of visiting Kor Zena'i, nodding thoughtfully at various insights.
units.italian: Ascolta con attenzione il tuo resoconto della visita a Kor Zena'i, annuendo pensieroso alle varie osservazioni.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Scent of Rain 1|	"Thank you for investigating this, <first>. I will ensure that our engineers get your data immediately, and brief our patrols to be aware of this increased capacity." His gestures have a tone of anticipation and regret.|706|0
units.english: "Thank you for investigating this, <first>. I will ensure that our engineers get your data immediately, and brief our patrols to be aware of this increased capacity." His gestures have a tone of anticipation and regret.
units.italian: "Grazie per aver indagato, <first>. Farò in modo che i nostri ingegneri ricevano subito i tuoi dati e informerò le nostre pattuglie di questa maggiore capacità." I suoi gesti hanno un tono di attesa e rammarico.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Scent of Rain 1|	"You are welcome."|708|0
units.english: "You are welcome."
units.italian: "Di niente."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Scent of Rain 1|	"Are you expecting something?"|710|0
units.english: "Are you expecting something?"
units.italian: "Ti aspetti qualcosa?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Scent of Rain 1|	Chilia smiles wistfully. "Do you know that feeling, when the whole world is still and the skies are clear, and yet you know in your bones that a storm is coming?" He continues without waiting for a response. "Well, I have had that feeling for decades, growing ever stronger. And now..." He pauses, drawing a deep breath. "Now, it feels like this is the first scent of rain. The first thing I can actually identify as a solid indicator that a storm is brewing."|711|0
units.english: Chilia smiles wistfully. "Do you know that feeling, when the whole world is still and the skies are clear, and yet you know in your bones that a storm is coming?" He continues without waiting for a response. "Well, I have had that feeling for decades, growing ever stronger. And now..." He pauses, drawing a deep breath. "Now, it feels like this is the first scent of rain. The first thing I can actually identify as a solid indicator that a storm is brewing."
units.italian: Chilia sorride con nostalgia. "Conosci quella sensazione, quando il mondo intero è immobile e i cieli sono limpidi, eppure sai nelle ossa che sta arrivando una tempesta?" Continua senza aspettare risposta. "Beh, io provo quella sensazione da decenni, sempre più forte. E ora..." Si ferma, tirando un respiro profondo. "Ora sembra che questo sia il primo odore di pioggia. La prima cosa che riesco davvero a identificare come indicatore solido che una tempesta si sta addensando."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Scent of Rain 1|	He shakes his head. "But no matter. Planning for the storm is my duty, not yours, and the front is yet to appear.|712|0
units.english: He shakes his head. "But no matter. Planning for the storm is my duty, not yours, and the front is yet to appear.
units.italian: Scuote la testa. "Ma non importa. Pianificare la tempesta è compito mio, non tuo, e il fronte deve ancora comparire.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Scent of Rain 1|label|713|0

units.italian: scanning payment

units.english: "We have allocated you <payment> for the risks undertaken. Please use it wisely. While it is my duty to anticipate threats to us all, it is your duty to ensure you are prepared to face the winds they may bring." units.italian: "Ti abbiamo assegnato <payment> per i rischi corsi. Usalo con saggezza. Se è mio dovere prevedere le minacce per tutti noi, è tuo dovere assicurarti di essere pronto ad affrontare i venti che potranno portare." Si volta e si allontana a grandi passi, svanendo in fretta nelle gallerie sotto lo spazioporto.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Will Not Someone Please Think Of The Children|description|722|0
units.context: mission:Remnant: Will Not Someone Please Think Of The Children
units.english: Travel to the <waypoints> system to disable a stranded Dathnak A'awoj. Do not destroy or capture the ship, as it likely has a large civilian population.
units.italian: Recati nel sistema <waypoints> per mettere fuori uso un Dathnak A'awoj rimasto bloccato. Non distruggere né catturare la nave, perché probabilmente trasporta una grande popolazione civile.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Will Not Someone Please Think Of The Children|You step out of your airlock to find Prefect Chilia waiting for you with a worried look on his face. "Captain <first>, I have a sensitive request for you.|736|0
units.context: mission:Remnant: Will Not Someone Please Think Of The Children
units.english: You step out of your airlock to find Prefect Chilia waiting for you with a worried look on his face. "Captain <first>, I have a sensitive request for you.
units.italian: Esci dalla camera di equilibrio e trovi il Prefetto Chilia che ti aspetta con un'espressione preoccupata. "Capitano <first>, ho una richiesta delicata per te.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Will Not Someone Please Think Of The Children|	"Our scouts are reporting a stranded Korath ship in Vaticanus, a Dathnak A'awoj to be precise. If it were a typical warship obstructing our operations, we would request you track it down and eliminate it, but because ships of this type tend to be home to a large civilian population, destroying or capturing it outright may instigate a reprisal, especially in that sector.|737|0
units.context: mission:Remnant: Will Not Someone Please Think Of The Children
units.english: "Our scouts are reporting a stranded Korath ship in Vaticanus, a Dathnak A'awoj to be precise. If it were a typical warship obstructing our operations, we would request you track it down and eliminate it, but because ships of this type tend to be home to a large civilian population, destroying or capturing it outright may instigate a reprisal, especially in that sector.
units.italian: "Le nostre sonde riferiscono di una nave Korath bloccata a Vaticanus, un Dathnak A'awoj per l'esattezza. Se fosse una tipica nave da guerra che ostacola le nostre operazioni, ti chiederemmo di rintracciarla ed eliminarla, ma dato che le navi di questo tipo tendono a ospitare una grande popolazione civile, distruggerla o catturarla di netto potrebbe scatenare una ritorsione, soprattutto in quel settore.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Will Not Someone Please Think Of The Children|	"Would you be up for disabling it, so the threat is eliminated while preserving the lives of the innocents on board?" His signs shift from a questioning tone to a confident one. "After you are done we can disarm the ship and fix their jump drive. If they adhere to their typical doctrine they should decide to head back home."|738|0
units.context: mission:Remnant: Will Not Someone Please Think Of The Children
units.english: "Would you be up for disabling it, so the threat is eliminated while preserving the lives of the innocents on board?" His signs shift from a questioning tone to a confident one. "After you are done we can disarm the ship and fix their jump drive. If they adhere to their typical doctrine they should decide to head back home."
units.italian: "Te la sentiresti di metterla fuori uso, così da eliminare la minaccia preservando la vita degli innocenti a bordo?" I suoi segni passano da un tono interrogativo a uno sicuro. "Quando avrai finito, potremo disarmare la nave e riparare il loro motore di salto. Se seguono la loro dottrina tipica, dovrebbero decidere di tornare a casa."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Will Not Someone Please Think Of The Children|	"Happy to help those in need, even the Korath."|740|0
units.context: mission:Remnant: Will Not Someone Please Think Of The Children
units.english: "Happy to help those in need, even the Korath."
units.italian: "Felice di aiutare chi è in difficoltà, anche i Korath."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Will Not Someone Please Think Of The Children|	"I have no intentions of risking my neck for some Korath."|741|0
units.context: mission:Remnant: Will Not Someone Please Think Of The Children
units.english: "I have no intentions of risking my neck for some Korath."
units.italian: "Non ho intenzione di rischiare il collo per dei Korath."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Will Not Someone Please Think Of The Children|	"I am grateful for your understanding and willingness to help here. Together we can ensure everyone gets home safely."|743|0
units.context: mission:Remnant: Will Not Someone Please Think Of The Children
units.english: "I am grateful for your understanding and willingness to help here. Together we can ensure everyone gets home safely."
units.italian: "Sono grato per la tua comprensione e la tua disponibilità ad aiutare. Insieme possiamo assicurarci che tutti tornino a casa sani e salvi."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Will Not Someone Please Think Of The Children|label|745|0
units.context: mission:Remnant: Will Not Someone Please Think Of The Children

units.italian: rather not

units.id: mission:Remnant: Will Not Someone Please Think Of The Children|	He nods in acknowledgment and his gestures take on a staccato phrasing. "I feared my ask was too much. I understand the sentiment. Perhaps I was naive to think such an outcome was possible."|746|0
units.context: mission:Remnant: Will Not Someone Please Think Of The Children
units.english: He nods in acknowledgment and his gestures take on a staccato phrasing. "I feared my ask was too much. I understand the sentiment. Perhaps I was naive to think such an outcome was possible."
units.italian: Annuisce in segno di riconoscimento e i suoi gesti prendono una fraseggiatura staccata. "Temevo che la mia richiesta fosse troppo. Capisco il sentimento. Forse ero ingenuo a pensare che un esito del genere fosse possibile."

units.english: You have disabled the Dathnak A'awoj. Time to report back to <planet>.
units.italian: Hai messo fuori uso il Dathnak A'awoj. È ora di riferire su <planet>.

units.context: mission:Remnant: Will Not Someone Please Think Of The Children
units.english: As you enter the system you spot the target ship. You imagine the small town's worth of people inside, many of which are probably children.
units.italian: Mentre entri nel sistema avvisti la nave bersaglio. Immagini il paese che vale di gente che c'è dentro, molti dei quali probabilmente bambini.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Will Not Someone Please Think Of The Children|dialog|765|0
units.context: mission:Remnant: Will Not Someone Please Think Of The Children
units.english: The Remnant are puzzled at your aborting of this mission, but they tell you they will send someone else to do this work. They warn you they will not propose any more of the sort to you again.
units.italian: I Remnant sono perplessi per il tuo annullamento di questa missione, ma ti dicono che manderanno qualcun altro a fare questo lavoro. Ti avvertono che non ti proporranno più incarichi del genere.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Will Not Someone Please Think Of The Children|dialog|768|0
units.context: mission:Remnant: Will Not Someone Please Think Of The Children
units.english: You were unable to disable the Dathnak A'awoj without destroying it... The Remnant will not be pleased...
units.italian: Non sei riuscito a mettere fuori uso il Dathnak A'awoj senza distruggerlo... I Remnant non saranno contenti...

units.italian: Quando atterri trovi Chilia con un'espressione sollevata.

units.context: mission:Remnant: Will Not Someone Please Think Of The Children
units.english: "These assignments are typically handled by our most trusted teams, as taking on the larger Korath vessels is a sensitive matter. Most of their larger ships are home to large groups of Korath civilians, including children. I must admit there were concerns you might not be those children's best chance, but our fleet was occupied elsewhere at the time. I am glad I was not wrong in my assessment of you," he signs with a content smile on his face.
units.italian: "Incarichi come questo sono di solito affidati alle nostre squadre più fidate, perché affrontare le navi Korath più grandi è una questione delicata. La maggior parte delle loro navi più grandi ospita grandi gruppi di civili Korath, bambini compresi. Devo ammettere che c'erano dubbi sul fatto che tu fossi la migliore possibilità per quei bambini, ma la nostra flotta era impegnata altrove. Sono contento di non essermi sbagliato nel mio giudizio su di te," segna con un sorriso soddisfatto.

units.context: mission:Remnant: Will Not Someone Please Think Of The Children
units.english: "We must be careful not to let ignorance of Korath society result in the unnecessary destruction of similar ships. Now that you have shown you can handle these tasks with the proper finesse, you can expect these to turn up in the task board in the future." Chilia then walks away with a confident pace.
units.italian: "Dobbiamo stare attenti a non lasciare che l'ignoranza della società Korath porti alla distruzione inutile di navi simili. Ora che hai dimostrato di saper gestire questi incarichi con la giusta finezza, puoi aspettarti che ricompaiano nella bacheca degli incarichi in futuro." Chilia poi si allontana con passo sicuro.
